source: Written for this app (not the games' dialogue). Every trainer has three sets of lines; one set is picked per battle. Lines never name Pokémon or types or hint at a trainer's team: each trainer has their own personality, drawn from their class, their look (sprite) and life in Alola (places, food, customs). Both closing remarks call back to their greeting. Special trainers and Battle Legends speak in character.

Florian.greeting: These board shorts have explored every tide pool on Melemele. Ready to get soaked?
Florian.trainerWins: Soaked you! The tide pools taught me well.
Florian.trainerLoses: I'm the one who got soaked... I'll go dry off on Route 1.

Florian.greeting: I've got a shell from every beach in Alola. A win from up here would be the shiniest one yet!
Florian.trainerWins: Shiniest prize in my whole collection!
Florian.trainerLoses: No shell for me today... just sand in my shorts.

Florian.greeting: Arms out wide like I'm catching a wave! That's my battle stance. Cool, right?
Florian.trainerWins: Caught the wave and rode it all the way in!
Florian.trainerLoses: Wiped out... I'll practice my stance at Hau'oli Beach.

Robin.greeting: I race the ferry from Hau'oli to Heahea every weekend. On foot. Along the shore. I'm fast!
Robin.trainerWins: First place again! Nobody beats me to the finish!
Robin.trainerLoses: Second place?! That's the first loser!

Robin.greeting: Bet I can win before you finish saying 'Alola'!
Robin.trainerWins: Ha! You didn't even get to the 'la'!
Robin.trainerLoses: You said the whole thing... and I still lost.

Robin.greeting: Mom says these shorts are too loud. I say they're racing stripes!
Robin.trainerLoses: Maybe Mom was right about these shorts...

Max.greeting: I give everything maximum effort, even eating shave ice! Brain freeze can't stop me!
Max.trainerLoses: Ugh... that loss hit harder than a brain freeze.

Max.greeting: I practiced my Z-pose in the mirror all week. Check out these arms!
Max.trainerWins: And THAT'S how you finish with a pose!
Max.trainerLoses: My pose was perfect. My battling... not so much.

Max.greeting: MAXIMUM VOLUME! MAXIMUM POWER! MAXIMUM... uh, battling! Let's go!
Max.trainerWins: MAXIMUM VICTORY! I'm gonna lose my voice!
Max.trainerLoses: minimum... victory... I need to sit down.

Bert.greeting: My big brother finished his island challenge. Now it's my turn to get famous!
Bert.trainerWins: Wait till my brother hears about this!
Bert.trainerLoses: Don't tell my brother. He'll never let me forget it.

Bert.greeting: These are my brother's old shorts. They're lucky! And a little big. But lucky!
Bert.trainerWins: Lucky AND they stayed up the whole battle!
Bert.trainerLoses: My brother's shorts... my brother's luck... gone.

Bert.greeting: I spent all summer training on Melemele while my brother was away. Look at this sunburn!
Bert.trainerLoses: Sunburned AND beaten. Some summer, huh?

Sophia.greeting: I picked this hibiscus for my hair on Route 2. My battling is even prettier!
Sophia.trainerWins: Pretty and victorious, just like my hibiscus!
Sophia.trainerLoses: My hibiscus is wilting... and so am I.

Sophia.greeting: Every morning I water the flowers in Malie Garden before school. Today, I'll grow a win!
Sophia.trainerLoses: Maybe I need to water it a little more...

Sophia.greeting: Flowers look soft, but they grow through rocks. So do I!
Sophia.trainerWins: Right through the rocks, just like I said!
Sophia.trainerLoses: This rock was too tough to grow through...

Shanta.greeting: I bought this green skirt at a Hau'oli boutique. It's my lucky battle skirt!
Shanta.trainerLoses: Back to the boutique for a luckier color...

Shanta.greeting: I matched my hair clip to my skirt AND my shoes. Battling in style is half the fun!
Shanta.trainerLoses: My outfit was perfect. My battle wasn't.

Shanta.greeting: Let's make this quick. My shave ice is melting in the lobby!
Shanta.trainerWins: Done! And my shave ice is still cold!
Shanta.trainerLoses: My shave ice melted... and so did my pride.

Rachel.greeting: My friends dared me to climb the Battle Tree. I'll send them a victory selfie!
Rachel.trainerLoses: No selfie for this one. Delete, delete, delete...

Rachel.greeting: A win here means bragging rights at the Pokémon Center café!
Rachel.trainerLoses: Guess I'll be quiet at the café today.

Rachel.greeting: Everyone at school says I talk too much. Let's see if my battling talks louder!

Chan.greeting: I read every battling book in the Malie Library. Chapter one: win!
Chan.trainerLoses: I'll be checking out more books from Malie...

Chan.greeting: My flower clip came from Malie Garden. I wear it on library days for luck!
Chan.trainerLoses: Maybe I need a new lucky charm...

Chan.greeting: Battling is just like reading. You have to know how the story ends before it does!
Chan.trainerWins: And they all lived happily ever after. Especially me!
Chan.trainerLoses: I didn't see that plot twist coming...

Ferdinand.greeting: My sun hat is my knight's helmet! I'm the bravest knight in Hau'oli!
Ferdinand.trainerLoses: My helmet fell off... and so did my winning.

Ferdinand.greeting: Mommy gave me a malasada for being brave. I'm SO brave!
Ferdinand.trainerWins: Brave AND a winner! Mommy owes me another malasada!
Ferdinand.trainerLoses: I'm still brave. Just a little sad.

Ferdinand.greeting: Knights never run away! Not even from the big waves at Hau'oli Beach!
Ferdinand.trainerWins: Knights never run, and knights always win!
Ferdinand.trainerLoses: I didn't run away... I just lost. That's okay, right?

Rico.greeting: I climbed every step of the Battle Tree with my own legs! I'm big now!
Rico.trainerLoses: Maybe I'm still a little bit small...

Rico.greeting: I tied my own shoes today! Battling is easy after that!
Rico.trainerLoses: I think my shoe came untied...

Rico.greeting: I don't need help from grown-ups! I can do this all by myself!
Rico.trainerLoses: Maybe... just a little help next time.

Rocky.greeting: I built a sandcastle at Hau'oli Beach this morning! Now I'm gonna build a win!
Rocky.trainerWins: Win built! Taller than my sandcastle!
Rocky.trainerLoses: My win got knocked down like my sandcastle...

Rocky.greeting: When I grow up, I'm gonna drive the big trucks that build roads! Vroom vroom!
Rocky.trainerLoses: Beep beep... backing up... I lost.

Rocky.greeting: I dug a hole all the way to the other side of the sandbox! I'm super strong!
Rocky.trainerLoses: Maybe I dug myself into a hole...

Jasper.greeting: I stayed up past bedtime watching the Battle Royal on TV. Now it's my turn!
Jasper.trainerLoses: Yawn... I should've gone to bed.

Jasper.greeting: I'm not sleepy! I'm... yawn... totally awake! Let's battle!
Jasper.trainerWins: See? Totally awake! And a winner!
Jasper.trainerLoses: Okay... maybe I'm a little sleepy... zzz...

Jasper.greeting: My cousin works at the Hano Grand Resort. He says I can beat anybody!

Kendra.greeting: I'm gonna draw a picture of this battle with ALL my crayons!
Kendra.trainerWins: Now I know exactly what to draw!
Kendra.trainerLoses: I'll draw you instead. You were really good.

Kendra.greeting: I drew a rainbow over Hau'oli Beach yesterday! Today I'll draw a winner: me!
Kendra.trainerLoses: I'll need to erase that winner picture...

Kendra.greeting: My cap has crayon on it. That's how you know I'm an artist!

Mercy.greeting: My big sister says I'm too little to battle here. Hmph! Watch me!
Mercy.trainerWins: Too little? Ha! Wait till I tell my big sister!
Mercy.trainerLoses: Don't tell my big sister, okay?

Mercy.greeting: I'm four and three-quarters! That's almost five! I'm practically grown up!
Mercy.trainerLoses: Maybe I need to be five first...

Mercy.greeting: My sister has a cooler dress, but I have a cooler team! Let's go!
Mercy.trainerLoses: Okay... maybe her dress AND her battling are cooler.

Helen.greeting: I give everybody hugs! After I win, you can have one too!
Helen.trainerWins: Hug time! You can have one!
Helen.trainerLoses: Can I still have a hug? I'm sad...

Helen.greeting: We had a luau at my house last night! I'm still full of energy!
Helen.trainerWins: Luau energy wins! I could battle all night!
Helen.trainerLoses: I think the luau energy wore off...

Helen.greeting: My cap keeps the sun out of my eyes so I can see you lose!
Helen.trainerWins: I saw it all! You lost!
Helen.trainerLoses: I saw it all... I lost.

Gladys.greeting: If I win, Grandpa's taking me to the malasada shop in Hau'oli! Sweet ones!
Gladys.trainerLoses: I'll get a sour malasada... to match my mood.

Gladys.greeting: Grandpa says I'm the strongest girl on Melemele. Grandpa's always right!
Gladys.trainerLoses: Grandpa was a little bit wrong today...

Gladys.greeting: I wore my best dress to the Battle Tree! Do I look like a champion?
Gladys.trainerWins: I look like a champion AND I am one!
Gladys.trainerLoses: I look like a champion. I just didn't battle like one.

Darla.greeting: I mark every battle on my map of Alola. Let's put a gold star on Poni Island!
Darla.trainerWins: Gold star on the map for Poni Island!
Darla.trainerLoses: This spot gets a little frowny face.

Darla.greeting: I've drawn every trail on all four islands. This tree's the last blank spot on my map!
Darla.trainerLoses: Still one blank spot left on my map...

Darla.greeting: Thumbs up! My compass, my pencil and my backpack never let me down!
Darla.trainerWins: Compass true, pencil sharp, win secured!
Darla.trainerLoses: Compass must be broken... I'm lost.

Tammy.greeting: Thumbs up! I walked here from Seafolk Village. Slowly. Very slowly.
Tammy.trainerLoses: Long, slow walk back to Seafolk...

Tammy.greeting: It's not about the destination, it's about the journey. But the destination is winning.
Tammy.trainerLoses: The journey continues... without a win.

Tammy.greeting: I stop to smell every flower on every route. It takes forever. I'm very patient.
Tammy.trainerWins: Patience pays off! Smell that victory!

Reese.greeting: I collect a souvenir from every town. Malie has the best ones. Today: a win!
Reese.trainerWins: Best souvenir yet! Way better than a key chain.
Reese.trainerLoses: A loss... not the souvenir I wanted.

Reese.greeting: My backpack is ninety percent souvenirs and ten percent snacks. Let's go!
Reese.trainerLoses: Ninety percent souvenirs, zero percent wins...

Reese.greeting: I bought this backpack at the Royal Avenue Megamart. It fits a hundred souvenirs!
Reese.trainerWins: Room for one more souvenir: victory!
Reese.trainerLoses: Guess I'll just carry my disappointment home.

Kayla.greeting: I've hiked every trail on Akala, from Brooklet Hill to the volcano. Let's go!
I tell spooky stories around the campfire every night. Want to hear one? It's about you losing!
Kayla.trainerWins: And THAT'S how the story ends! Boo!
Kayla.trainerLoses: Spooky... I'm the one who's scared now.

Kayla.greeting: Thumbs up, straps tight! I'm ready for anything you throw at me!
Kayla.trainerWins: Ready for anything, and anything included you!

Cleavant.greeting: Hah! I've hauled this pack to the top of Mount Lanakila three times!
Cleavant.trainerLoses: This tree is steeper than Lanakila ever was...

Cleavant.greeting: Every summit in Alola, I've stood on it. This tree is the last peak on my list!
Cleavant.trainerLoses: One peak left on the list... for now.

Cleavant.greeting: My bandana's soaked with the sweat of a thousand climbs. Let's add one more!
Cleavant.trainerWins: One more climb, one more win!
Cleavant.trainerLoses: Too much sweat, not enough strength...

Buster.greeting: Hohoho! A strapping young Trainer! You'll make a fine warm-up!
Buster.trainerLoses: Hohoho... I'm the one who got warmed up!

Buster.greeting: Hohoho! My belly laugh echoes off every cliff in Alola!
Buster.trainerWins: Hear that echo? That's victory! Hohoho!
Buster.trainerLoses: Hohoho... ho... the echo sounds sad today.

Buster.greeting: I eat a whole plate lunch before every climb! Hohoho, I'm full of energy!
Buster.trainerLoses: Hohoho... I think I need another plate lunch.

Arlo.greeting: Out on the trail, you learn to never give up. Let's see if you've learned that too!
Arlo.trainerWins: The trail teaches patience. You'll get there someday.
Arlo.trainerLoses: You've clearly walked a harder trail than I have.

Arlo.greeting: Every step teaches you something. This battle will teach one of us something too.
Arlo.trainerWins: Lesson for you today. Keep walking.
Arlo.trainerLoses: Lesson learned. I'll walk it off.

Arlo.greeting: This beard has seen every trail on Ula'ula. It's never seen me lose!
Arlo.trainerLoses: My beard is ashamed of me...

Levine.greeting: I carry boulders up Mount Hokulani for training. A battle is a nice break!
Levine.trainerWins: Lighter than a boulder, that battle!
Levine.trainerLoses: That loss weighs more than any boulder.

Levine.greeting: See these arms? I carried my pack AND a friend's pack up the Ancient Poni Path!
Levine.trainerLoses: My arms are fine. My pride is sore.

Levine.greeting: Lift with your legs, battle with your heart! That's my motto!
Levine.trainerLoses: I must have lifted with my back...

Percy.greeting: I loosened my tie for this battle. That's how serious I am!
Percy.trainerLoses: Better tighten my tie and get back to work...

Percy.greeting: I commute from Hau'oli every morning. Battling on Poni Island is my vacation!
I used up a vacation day for this. Make it worth the paperwork!
Percy.trainerWins: Worth every form I filled out!
Percy.trainerLoses: Now I have to explain this to my boss...

Conley.greeting: I've blocked out exactly fifteen minutes in my planner for this battle.
Conley.trainerWins: Finished early! Back to my planner.
Conley.trainerLoses: I'll need to reschedule my whole afternoon...

Conley.greeting: Pau hana! Work's done, so it's battle time!
Conley.trainerWins: Best pau hana ever! Now for a cold drink by the marina.

Conley.greeting: My watch is set two minutes fast so I'm never late. I won't be late to winning either!
Conley.trainerLoses: Late to the victory... it left without me.

Emery.greeting: My confidence is like the stock market on a good day: way up!
Emery.trainerLoses: Market crash... my confidence is in free fall.

Emery.greeting: This is my best white shirt. I'll keep it spotless while I win.
Emery.trainerWins: Not a single stain! Shirt's clean, record's clean.
Emery.trainerLoses: Is that... a stain? Ugh, what a day.

Emery.greeting: I'm investing in a winning streak. High risk, high reward!
Emery.trainerLoses: High risk... and I paid for it.

Winnie.greeting: After a long week at the Hau'oli office, a battle is my favorite way to unwind!
Winnie.trainerWins: Totally unwound! Better than a weekend at Hano Beach.
Winnie.trainerLoses: Now I'm wound up tighter than before...

Winnie.greeting: I keep a stress ball on my desk. Today, you're my stress ball!
Winnie.trainerWins: Squeezed! I feel so much better.
Winnie.trainerLoses: I think I'm the stress ball now...

Winnie.greeting: These slacks are office-ready AND battle-ready. Let's go!

Prudence.greeting: I made a slideshow on my battle strategy. Slide one: you lose.
Prudence.trainerWins: Final slide: I win. Any questions?
Prudence.trainerLoses: Back to slide one... all of them, really.

Prudence.greeting: I color-code everything: my calendar, my notes, my battle plans. This one's red for victory!
Prudence.trainerLoses: I'll need a new color for this... gray, maybe.

Prudence.greeting: I took the ferry from Akala just for this. It had better be worth it!
Prudence.trainerWins: Worth every wave of that ferry ride!
Prudence.trainerLoses: A long, seasick ferry ride home...

Dominica.greeting: I'm up for a promotion. A Battle Tree win would look great on my résumé!
Dominica.trainerWins: That's going straight on my résumé!
Dominica.trainerLoses: I'll leave this one off the résumé...

Dominica.greeting: My boss is watching the Battle Tree broadcast today. No pressure!
Dominica.trainerWins: Boss, if you're watching: promotion, please!
Dominica.trainerLoses: Boss, if you're watching... please stop watching.

Dominica.greeting: I brought a poke bowl for lunch. I'll bring home a win too!
Dominica.trainerWins: Lunch AND a win. So ono!
Dominica.trainerLoses: Lunch was ono. That battle wasn't.

Kass.greeting: Yo! You look like you need a lesson in how we do things in Po Town!
Kass.trainerWins: Lesson over, yo! Hope you took notes!
Kass.trainerLoses: Yo... I think I just got schooled.

Kass.greeting: Class is in session, yo! Professor Kass, teaching the streets!
Kass.trainerLoses: Professor Kass... got held back a year.

Kass.greeting: These wristbands are just for show. My battling is for real!
Kass.trainerWins: The real deal, yo! Wristbands just make it look good.
Kass.trainerLoses: Guess the wristbands were all I had...

Scoop.greeting: Word on Route 17 says you've been winning a lot. Time to fix that!
Scoop.trainerWins: Word on Route 17 is: you lost!
Scoop.trainerLoses: Word's gonna spread... that I lost.

Scoop.greeting: I hear everything that goes down in Po Town. Today, the news is you losing!
Scoop.trainerWins: Breaking news: I won! Spread the word!
Scoop.trainerLoses: Breaking news... please don't spread it.

Scoop.greeting: I wore my best tank top up here. Don't make me sweat.

Dylan.greeting: My crew's got the loudest boombox in Alola! Let's crank it up!
Dylan.trainerWins: Loud and proud! They heard that all the way in Po Town!

Dylan.greeting: I skated all the way down Route 10 to get here. Ready to wipe out?
Dylan.trainerWins: You wiped out! Should've worn knee pads, kid.
Dylan.trainerLoses: I'm the one who wiped out...

Dylan.greeting: Every battle's got a soundtrack. Mine's heavy on the bass!
Dylan.trainerLoses: Record scratch... that's my soundtrack ending.

Evander.greeting: Don't let the tough act fool ya. I'm tough on the inside, too!
Evander.trainerLoses: Okay... maybe a little soft on the inside.

Evander.greeting: I hang around the Malie City docks. Tough place, tougher Trainers.
Evander.trainerLoses: Guess I'm not that tough after all...

Evander.greeting: I don't cry at sad movies. That was rain. In the theater. Shut up and battle!
Evander.trainerLoses: ...It's raining again. In here. Don't look.

Myrna.greeting: Pink hair, bad attitude. Got a problem with that?
Myrna.trainerWins: Didn't think so! Pink hair stays undefeated.
Myrna.trainerLoses: Fine, I've got a problem now. It's you.

Myrna.greeting: Oh wow, another Trainer. How totally thrilling. Let's get this over with.
Myrna.trainerLoses: Okay, THAT was actually thrilling. Ugh.

Myrna.greeting: This is my lucky cap. Touch it and you lose.

Eva.greeting: Pink hair, black top, sharp style. Everything about me has an edge!
Eva.trainerWins: Sliced right through you! Told you I was all edge.
Eva.trainerLoses: Lost my edge... and my style points.

Eva.greeting: I design my own outfits. This one's called 'Your Defeat.' Like it?
Eva.trainerWins: 'Your Defeat' is a hit! New collection coming soon.
Eva.trainerLoses: Back to the drawing board for my new collection...

Eva.greeting: I hang out at the Hau'oli Marina scaring tourists. You're next.
Eva.trainerWins: Shoo, shoo! Just like the tourists!
Eva.trainerLoses: Even the tourists are laughing at me.

Agrata.greeting: Rules are for Trainers' School kids. Up here, I make my own!
Agrata.trainerWins: My rules, my win! Write that down, Trainers' School kid.
Agrata.trainerLoses: Okay... maybe rules aren't so bad.

Agrata.greeting: I've been kicked out of three malasada shops. Don't ask why.
Agrata.trainerWins: Four shops! Kidding. Kind of. I won!
Agrata.trainerLoses: Maybe I'll behave at the next malasada shop...

Agrata.greeting: My skirt's short, my temper's shorter. Let's go!
Agrata.trainerWins: Told you my temper was short! So was the battle.
Agrata.trainerLoses: My temper's gone. So is my win.

Abby.greeting: I drum on everything. Trash cans, railings, your team. Let's make some noise!
Abby.trainerLoses: ...My drumsticks broke. Don't look at me.

Abby.greeting: I painted my nails black for this battle. Like my mood.
Abby.trainerLoses: Chipped a nail. And my pride.

Abby.greeting: I'm gonna make enough noise to shake Poni Island!
Abby.trainerWins: Poni Island shook! Did you feel it? I felt it!

Parker.greeting: See this bat? I hit homers at the Hau'oli ball field. Now I'm swinging for you!
Parker.trainerWins: Home run! That one's going over the outfield fence!

Parker.greeting: I've hit a ball clean into Hau'oli Bay. Twice! Want to see a third?
Parker.trainerWins: Splash! Third one's in the bay!
Parker.trainerLoses: That one didn't even reach the infield...

Parker.greeting: I ran laps around Iki Town this morning. Warmed up and ready!
Parker.trainerWins: Workout complete! Those laps paid off!

Isaac.greeting: Coach says the Iki Town team never quits. Batter up!
Coach makes us shout 'hustle!' before every game. HUSTLE!
This bat's signed by my whole team. It's my lucky charm!
Isaac.trainerLoses: Guess I need to get it signed again...

Ayden.greeting: Battling's like baseball: three outs and you're done. Let's play ball!
Ayden.trainerLoses: Three outs... I'm the one who's done.

Ayden.greeting: I study every pitcher in the Alola league. I know exactly what's coming!
I run sprints on Big Wave Beach. Sand training makes me unstoppable!
Ayden.trainerWins: Unstoppable! All that sand training paid off!
Ayden.trainerLoses: Stopped cold, right in the sand...

Alwyn.greeting: My serve is the fastest on the Hau'oli tennis courts. Try to return it!
Alwyn.trainerWins: Ace! You never even touched that serve!

Alwyn.greeting: I sprint up the Route 2 hills before school every day. Keep up!
I practice my serve against the Trainers' School wall. The wall's never won!
Alwyn.trainerWins: Still undefeated, just like against the wall!
Alwyn.trainerLoses: Lost to someone who isn't a wall...

Mardea.greeting: Racket ready, shoes laced, water bottle full. Let's play a set!
Mardea.trainerLoses: Lost the set... and the match. Rematch?

Mardea.greeting: Stretching, check. Sunscreen, check. Victory... coming right up!
Mardea.trainerLoses: I forgot to check one thing: how strong you are.

Mardea.greeting: I trained on the Akala courts in the afternoon heat. A battle is nothing!

Gabriella.greeting: I play beach volleyball at Hano Beach every weekend. Ready for a spike?
Gabriella.trainerWins: Spiked it! Straight into the sand!
Gabriella.trainerLoses: You blocked every spike I sent...

Gabriella.greeting: My racket has brand-new strings. Let's test them out!
Gabriella.trainerLoses: Snapped a string... and my winning streak.

Gabriella.greeting: Sand in my shoes, sun on my shoulders. Best way to battle!
Gabriella.trainerLoses: Sand in my shoes, and a loss on my record...

Ryder.greeting: I'm the next big thing in Alola. Lucky you, battling me before I'm famous!
Ryder.trainerWins: Remember this day! You'll be telling people about it someday.

Ryder.greeting: I've already practiced my autograph. Want to see it?
Ryder.trainerWins: Here you go! It'll be worth a lot someday!
Ryder.trainerLoses: Maybe I'll practice battling instead of autographs...

Ryder.greeting: Green polo, big smile, bright future. That's the Ryder brand!
Ryder.trainerWins: The Ryder brand is going places!

Christopher.greeting: Top of my class at the Trainers' School. This is my first real test.
Christopher.trainerLoses: Failed my first real test... I have a lot to study.

Christopher.greeting: I've never gotten anything lower than an A. Grade me!
Christopher.trainerLoses: That's... my first B. Maybe C.

Christopher.greeting: I took notes on every Trainer who climbed this tree. You're on page forty-two.
Christopher.trainerLoses: I'll need to rewrite page forty-two...

Sorley.greeting: My mentor says I'm a rising star, like the tide rising at Kala'e Bay!
Sorley.trainerWins: High tide! I keep rising, just like Kala'e Bay!
Sorley.trainerLoses: Low tide for me... the bay's empty.

Sorley.greeting: My mentor watches every battle I fight. Better make this one count!
I bow to every opponent, just like my mentor taught me. Then I win!
Sorley.trainerLoses: Bow... battle... lose. Not quite the way.

Beatrice.greeting: I've watched every match at the Battle Royal Dome. I know all the tricks!
Beatrice.trainerWins: Studied and solved! The Battle Royal Dome taught me well.
Beatrice.trainerLoses: You had tricks I've never seen!

Beatrice.greeting: I take notes on everything. Your first move is already in my notebook.
Beatrice.trainerWins: Exactly as written in my notebook!

Beatrice.greeting: My hair's up for battle! Down is for sunsets at Hano Beach.
Beatrice.trainerLoses: Hair's coming down... time for a sunset.

Brandi.greeting: Today's my Battle Tree debut! I'm so nervous... but so ready!
Brandi.trainerWins: What a debut! I'll remember this one forever.

Brandi.greeting: My hands are shaking, but my heart is steady. Let's go!
Brandi.trainerLoses: My hands were shaking for a reason...

Brandi.greeting: I practiced this moment in my head a hundred times. This is take one hundred and one!
Brandi.trainerWins: Take one hundred and one: perfect!

Marsha.greeting: I grew up on the boats of Seafolk Village. The sea taught me to never give up!
Marsha.trainerWins: Seafolk pride! The sea always takes care of us!
Marsha.trainerLoses: The sea is calm, and so am I. Sad, but calm.

Marsha.greeting: Everyone says I'm a rising star. Like the tide, I keep rising!
Marsha.trainerWins: Higher and higher! The tide keeps rising!

Marsha.greeting: My grandma fishes off the Seafolk docks every morning. She says I'm her best catch!
Marsha.trainerWins: Grandma's best catch, reeling in a win!
Marsha.trainerLoses: Grandma's going to throw me back...

Cooper.greeting: I came to Alola for the sights, but this battle is the main attraction!
Cooper.trainerWins: Best attraction on the whole trip!
Cooper.trainerLoses: This attraction was a bit too thrilling for me...

Cooper.greeting: I've ridden every tour boat around Akala. This tree beats all of them!
Yellow shirt, orange cap... I dress like a sunset over Hano Beach!
Cooper.trainerLoses: The sun set on me, all right.

Darien.greeting: Smile! I'm taking a photo of my victory before it even happens!
Darien.trainerWins: Perfect shot! That one's going on the fridge.
Darien.trainerLoses: Blurry photo... just like my strategy.

Darien.greeting: I've photographed every waterfall on Akala. You're my next subject!
Darien.trainerLoses: Out of focus. Just like me today.

Darien.greeting: My camera roll has ten thousand photos of Alola. Ten thousand and one, coming up!
Darien.trainerWins: Ten thousand and one: the winning shot!

Hart.greeting: I'm visiting from Kalos! Alola's sun is so bright, I never take this cap off.
Hart.trainerWins: A bright win under a bright sun!
Hart.trainerLoses: The sun's in my eyes. Yeah, that's it.

Hart.greeting: Bonjour! I mean... Alola! Still learning the local greeting.
Hart.trainerWins: Alola! See, I'm practically a local now!
Hart.trainerLoses: Au revoir... I mean... I lost.

Hart.greeting: I booked the Hano Grand Resort for a whole week. Plenty of time to win!
Hart.trainerWins: A vacation victory! Best week at the resort yet.
Hart.trainerLoses: Checking out of the resort early...

Kaula.greeting: This straw hat has shaded me on every beach in Alola. Today it shades a winner!
Kaula.trainerLoses: My hat blew away... along with my hopes.

Kaula.greeting: I bought a plumeria lei in Malie Garden. Smell that? That's victory!
Hano Beach in the morning, Big Wave Beach at noon, the Battle Tree by sunset!
Kaula.trainerWins: A perfect beach day, perfectly finished!

Charlene.greeting: I bought a guidebook just for this tree. Page twelve says I win!
Charlene.trainerLoses: I'd like a refund on this guidebook, please.

Charlene.greeting: This sundress is perfect for Alolan weather. Not so much for battles, but here we go!
My guidebook has a list of the top ten things to do in Alola. Number one: win here!

Odessa.greeting: My cruise ship leaves Hau'oli at sunset, so let's make this quick!
Odessa.trainerWins: And I'll make it back to the ship in time!

Odessa.greeting: The cruise director said 'don't battle at the Battle Tree.' I never listen!
Odessa.trainerLoses: Should've listened to the cruise director...

Odessa.greeting: This orange bag holds sunscreen, snacks and my ship's boarding pass. Ready!
Odessa.trainerWins: Packed for victory! Sunscreen, snacks and a win!

Jairo.greeting: I mop the Battle Tree lobby every morning. Let me mop up this battle too!
Jairo.trainerWins: All mopped up! The lobby AND the battle.
Jairo.trainerLoses: Looks like I'm the one who got mopped...

Jairo.greeting: Every tile in this lobby sparkles. I count them. Four thousand and twelve.
Jairo.trainerWins: Four thousand and twelve tiles, one win!
Jairo.trainerLoses: Lost count... and lost the battle.

Jairo.greeting: These coveralls have seen every spill on Poni Island. Nothing fazes me!

Xaden.greeting: Gray hair, blue coveralls, forty years on the job. Nobody outworks me.
Xaden.trainerWins: Forty years strong, and still outworking everyone!

Xaden.greeting: I've cleaned up after every Battle Legend who's climbed this tree. I've learned a thing or two.
Xaden.trainerLoses: Still learning, after all these years...

Xaden.greeting: I sweep sand off the Battle Tree steps all day. Sweeping you will be easy!
Xaden.trainerWins: Swept away, like sand off the steps!
Xaden.trainerLoses: I'm the one who got swept away...

Giles.greeting: I've seen a thousand battles from behind my broom. Now it's my turn!
Giles.trainerLoses: Back to my broom, I suppose.

Giles.greeting: Nobody notices the janitor. That's how I learned all their secrets.
Giles.trainerLoses: You had a secret I didn't know...

Giles.greeting: Quiet hands, sharp eyes. That's how you clean a lobby and win a battle.
Giles.trainerLoses: My eyes must be getting old...

Skip.greeting: Lunch break at the Malie construction site is short. Let's make this quick!
I eat my plate lunch in four minutes flat. Let's see how fast I win!
Skip.trainerLoses: Slower than lunch... and less filling.

Skip.greeting: Hard hat on, sleeves up! Thirty minutes till the whistle blows!
Skip.trainerLoses: There's the whistle... and I lost.

JT.greeting: I run the tallest crane on Ula'ula. Heights don't scare me!
JT.trainerLoses: Long way down from up here...

JT.greeting: From my crane, I can see all of Malie. From here, I can see my win!
JT.trainerWins: Saw it coming from a mile away!
JT.trainerLoses: Didn't see that coming, even from up high...

JT.greeting: Hard hat, harness, steady hands. Let's lift this battle up!

Benjamin.greeting: Safety first! Hard hat on, boots laced, battle ready!
Benjamin.trainerWins: No accidents, just a clean win!
Benjamin.trainerLoses: Good thing I wore my hard hat. That hit hard.

Benjamin.greeting: I've worked six hundred days without an accident. Let's keep the streak going!
Benjamin.trainerWins: Six hundred and one days! Safe and sound!
Benjamin.trainerLoses: Accident on the job site... my record's ruined.

Benjamin.greeting: Always check your surroundings before you swing. I've checked. You're going down.

Henry.greeting: Even a gentleman wears an Alola shirt on Poni Island. Shall we battle with grace?
Henry.trainerWins: Graceful to the very end. Splendid.
Henry.trainerLoses: You battle with more grace than I. Bravo.

Henry.greeting: Manners first, battling second. After you, young Trainer.
Henry.trainerWins: Thank you for your fine manners. And the win.
Henry.trainerLoses: Your manners AND your battling are impeccable.

Henry.greeting: I summer at the Hano Grand Resort and winter in Malie. Battles are my year-round pleasure.
Henry.trainerLoses: Not so pleasant this time, I'm afraid.

Ikram.greeting: I left my cocoa steaming on the lanai. Let's not let it cool, shall we?
Ikram.trainerLoses: My cocoa has gone cold. As have I.

Ikram.greeting: A gentleman never rushes. Except when his cocoa is getting cold.
My beard is as white as Hano Beach sand. My spirit is as warm as its sun!
Ikram.trainerLoses: Cooled right off, like the beach at sunset...

Jerry.greeting: Fine manners, fine Pokémon, fine floral shirt. A true gentleman has all three.
Jerry.trainerWins: And a fine victory to match.
Jerry.trainerLoses: Manners I have. Victory, it seems, I lack.

Jerry.greeting: I attended the luau in Iki Town last night. I'm still full of energy!
Jerry.trainerWins: Luau power! I may have to attend another.

Jerry.greeting: I danced the hula at my own wedding, forty years ago. I've still got the moves!
Jerry.trainerLoses: Perhaps my moves are a bit rusty...

Cheryl.greeting: Oh my, what a darling Trainer. Do you like my muumuu? It's from Konikoni City.
Cheryl.trainerWins: Darling, you lost! But you looked lovely doing it.
Cheryl.trainerLoses: Oh my... I'll wear a different dress next time.

Cheryl.greeting: Oh my, oh my! Such a serious face. Shall I make you a malasada after?
Cheryl.trainerWins: Oh my, here's your malasada, dear.
Cheryl.trainerLoses: Oh my... I need a malasada now.

Cheryl.greeting: My villa overlooks Hano Beach. I watch the sunset every evening, darling.
Cheryl.trainerLoses: The sunset will look sad tonight...

Christy.greeting: I collect pearls from the Konikoni jewelers, darling. And victories.
Christy.trainerLoses: My pearls have lost their luster...

Christy.greeting: Only the finest for me, darling. The finest pearls, the finest tea, the finest win.
Christy.trainerLoses: Darling, that was dreadfully inelegant of me.

Christy.greeting: This necklace has one hundred pearls. I'll add one more today!

Verna.greeting: These jewels are from Konikoni City, darling. Prepare to be dazzled!
Verna.trainerLoses: My jewels have lost their sparkle...

Verna.greeting: Rain or shine, I wear my diamonds. A lady must sparkle!
This dress has flowers, my rings have rubies. Darling, you're outmatched.

Duncan.greeting: Arms crossed means I'm confident. And I'm VERY confident.
My collection is legendary. Every piece is one of a kind!
Duncan.trainerWins: Another rare piece for the collection!
Duncan.trainerLoses: A loss... the one item I never wanted.

Duncan.greeting: I've hunted treasures from Ten Carat Hill to Vast Poni Canyon. You're my next find!

Nobunaga.greeting: My collection is complete, except for one thing: a win over you!
Nobunaga.trainerWins: Now my collection is truly complete!

Nobunaga.greeting: I trade at the Festival Plaza every day. I always get the better deal!
Nobunaga.trainerLoses: First bad trade of my life...

Nobunaga.greeting: I keep my rarest treasures in these pouches. Want to see what's inside?
Nobunaga.trainerWins: Surprise! Bet you didn't see that coming.

Arnon.greeting: Fore! This battle's going to be a hole in one!
Arnon.trainerWins: Hole in one, just like I called it!
Arnon.trainerLoses: Bogey... maybe even a double bogey.

Arnon.greeting: I yell 'Fore!' even when nobody's around. It's good luck!
Red visor, red polo... the sharpest dresser on the green!

Alim.greeting: Patience and precision: the secret to golf and to battling.
Alim.trainerWins: Right on target. Patience pays off.
Alim.trainerLoses: My precision was off today. You were spot-on.

Alim.greeting: I measure every putt three times. I've measured this battle too.
The trade winds off Poni are tricky, but my swing adjusts!
Alim.trainerWins: Adjusted perfectly! The trade winds are on my side.

Zeno.greeting: I usually play eighteen holes. This battle will be a quick nine.
Zeno.trainerLoses: Way over par... time to head to the clubhouse.

Zeno.greeting: Tee time's in twenty minutes! Let's speed this up!
I play fast, think fast and win fast. Ready, set, swing!
Zeno.trainerWins: Fast win! Back to the tee!
Zeno.trainerLoses: Too fast... I should've slowed down.

Anisa.greeting: My swing is perfect, and my battling is too. Let's tee off!
Anisa.trainerLoses: I sliced it right into the rough...

Anisa.greeting: I practice my swing a thousand times a day at the Hau'oli range. Perfection takes work!
I played a dawn round near Paniola Ranch. The cattle kept stepping on my ball.
Anisa.trainerWins: Still made par, even with the cattle on the course!

Calliope.greeting: Three tournaments this season. Shall we make it four?
Calliope.trainerWins: Four for four! What a season!
Calliope.trainerLoses: Three out of four is still a good season.

Calliope.greeting: Trophies on my mantel, trophies in my closet, trophies in my car. Room for one more!
My visor keeps the Alolan sun out of my eyes. I see the win clearly!

Christina.greeting: The wind is just right. Let's see where this battle lands!
Christina.trainerLoses: The wind must have shifted on me...

Christina.greeting: I can tell which way the wind blows just by licking my finger. Let's see!
I named all my clubs after golf courses on Melemele!
Christina.trainerLoses: Rain delay... on my winning streak.

Nedry.greeting: I raised every one of my Pokémon out at Paniola Ranch. Ranch-strong!
Nedry.trainerLoses: Back to the ranch for more training...

Nedry.greeting: Up at dawn, feed the herd, brush the coats, then battle! That's ranch life!
These overalls have pockets full of treats. My team knows it!
Nedry.trainerWins: Treat time! My team earned every one.

Sheridan.greeting: Love and good food make strong Pokémon. Let me show you!
Sheridan.trainerWins: Love and good food, that's the secret!
Sheridan.trainerLoses: I'd better feed them an extra treat tonight...

Sheridan.greeting: I cook three meals a day for my team. Four on battle days!
My hat keeps the sun off, and my overalls keep the mud off. Let's go!
Sheridan.trainerLoses: Muddy and beaten... my overalls didn't help.

Kiernan.greeting: Raising Pokémon takes patience. Battling them takes courage!
Kiernan.trainerLoses: I'll need a bit more patience...

Kiernan.greeting: I've got an Egg in my overalls right now, keeping it warm. Gotta win quick!
Kiernan.trainerWins: Hatched a win! And the Egg's still warm!
Kiernan.trainerLoses: Hatching a plan for next time...

Kiernan.greeting: I sat with an Egg for thirty days straight once. Waiting is my specialty.

Dara.greeting: My babies are all grown up now, and they're itching to battle!
Dara.trainerLoses: My poor babies... come here, let me hug you all.

Dara.greeting: I tuck in every one of my babies at night and sing them a lullaby. They're so well rested!
I feed my team Berries from my own garden. So ono!
Dara.trainerWins: An ono victory! The Berries worked!

Rada.greeting: I check every Pokémon's health each morning. They're in perfect shape!
Rada.trainerLoses: Time for an extra checkup, I think.

Rada.greeting: Temperature, appetite, energy: all perfect this morning! Let's battle!
Up with the sunrise on Route 5. The early bird gets the win!

Gertrude.greeting: I've bred Pokémon for forty years. Let's see if your team measures up.
Gertrude.trainerWins: Measured up and came up short. Keep training!
Gertrude.trainerLoses: Your team measures up just fine. More than fine.

Gertrude.greeting: My braids are older than your Pokédex. So's my experience!
Gertrude.trainerWins: Experience wins! My braids have seen it all.

Gertrude.greeting: Raised on Paniola Ranch, grown in the Alolan sun. Strong as the soil!
Gertrude.trainerLoses: Crop failure... the soil must be tired.

Dyson.greeting: Welcome to the Battle Tree! Allow me to check you in... to a loss!
Dyson.trainerWins: Thank you for your stay! Please come again!
Dyson.trainerLoses: I'm afraid I've been checked out...

Dyson.greeting: Your room is ready: the Losers' Suite, ocean view!
Dyson.trainerWins: Enjoy the suite! Room service is complimentary.
Dyson.trainerLoses: I'll be staying in the suite myself, it seems.

Dyson.greeting: A bow for my guest! Five-star service, five-star battle!
Dyson.trainerWins: Service complete! Thank you for choosing the Battle Tree.

Chip.greeting: I carry luggage all day at the Tide Song Hotel. Carrying a win is easy!
Chip.trainerLoses: Dropped the luggage... and the battle.

Chip.greeting: Twelve suitcases up four flights of stairs. Every morning. Ready!
Uniform pressed, bow perfected, game face on!
Chip.trainerWins: Perfect service, perfect bow, perfect win!

Zero.greeting: Service with a smile! But I won't go easy on you.
Zero.trainerWins: Still smiling! Service with a smile and a win.

Zero.greeting: I park cars at the Hano Grand Resort. Watch me park you in the loser's spot!
Zero.trainerWins: Parked! Right in the loser's spot.
Zero.trainerLoses: Towed away... and I didn't even get a ticket.

Zero.greeting: I've never stopped smiling, not once, in ten years. Try to wipe it off!
Zero.trainerWins: Smile intact! Ten years and counting!

Julien.greeting: Spicy malasadas are my specialty. Hope you can handle the heat!
Julien.trainerWins: Too spicy for you? I warned you!

Julien.greeting: A pinch of chili, a dash of sugar, and a whole lot of attitude. That's my recipe!
Julien.trainerLoses: Too much attitude, not enough sugar...

Julien.greeting: Apron on, ladle ready! Let's get cooking!
Julien.trainerWins: Order up! Hot and fresh, just how I like it.
Julien.trainerLoses: Overcooked... and I left the ladle in the pot.

Sly.greeting: My secret ingredient? A pinch of pure battle spirit!
Sly.trainerLoses: I must have forgotten the secret ingredient...

Sly.greeting: I run a poke stand in Heahea City. Fresh fish, fresh strategies!
Sly.trainerLoses: Spoiled... the fish AND the strategy.

Sly.greeting: I'll never tell you my sauce recipe. Or my battle plan!
Sly.trainerLoses: You must have figured out my recipe...

Noah.greeting: Battles are like stew: the longer they simmer, the better they taste!
Noah.trainerLoses: Overcooked... this one's going in the trash.

Noah.greeting: I serve loco moco at the Pokémon Center café. Today's special: your defeat!
Noah.trainerWins: Served hot! Loco moco and a win, the café special.

Noah.greeting: My ladle is as old as my recipes. Both still pack plenty of flavor!
Noah.trainerWins: Flavorful! My old ladle still has it.

Brantley.greeting: Hands together, deep breath. Firefighters always stay calm!
Brantley.trainerWins: Calm and collected, like a true firefighter!

Brantley.greeting: I've stayed calm through every emergency on Akala. A battle is nothing!
Wela Volcano Park is my beat. If I can handle lava, I can handle you!
Brantley.trainerLoses: Melted... and I thought I could handle lava.

Camber.greeting: Training at the Heahea fire station keeps me in top shape!
Camber.trainerLoses: Back to the station for more training.

Camber.greeting: I just passed my fire academy exam! Today's my first real test!
I slide down the fire pole faster than anyone at the station. Watch me go!

Rendor.greeting: Halt! You're under arrest for having too long a winning streak!
Rendor.trainerWins: Case closed! You have the right to remain defeated.
Rendor.trainerLoses: You're free to go... I couldn't hold you.

Rendor.greeting: I patrol Hau'oli City from the marina to the shopping district. Nothing gets by me!
Rendor.trainerWins: Nothing gets by me! Not even you.
Rendor.trainerLoses: Well, you got by me. Carry on, citizen.

Rendor.greeting: My mustache is regulation length. My battling is regulation strong!
Rendor.trainerWins: By the book, mustache and all!
Rendor.trainerLoses: Off the books... and my mustache is drooping.

Lou.greeting: I patrol the Haina Desert alone. Heat, sand, silence. I'm tough!
A dust storm on Route 13? Just another day on patrol.
Lou.trainerLoses: Blown away in my own patrol...

Lou.greeting: Cap straight, badge shined. Ready to enforce some rules!
Lou.trainerWins: Rules enforced! Cap straight, badge shining.
Lou.trainerLoses: Rule broken: me. My badge has lost its shine.

Benji.greeting: Justice is swift, and so am I!
Benji.trainerLoses: Justice was a little slow today...

Benji.greeting: I salute every challenger. Then I arrest their streak.
Benji.trainerWins: Arrested! Your streak's going to jail.
Benji.trainerLoses: Released... your streak's free to go.

Benji.greeting: I stand guard outside the Malie police station all day. Try to get past me!
Benji.trainerWins: Nobody gets past the Malie station!

Cal.greeting: My hypothesis: I defeat you. Let's run the experiment!
I research strange phenomena at the Dimensional Research Lab in Heahea. You're one of them!
Lab coat buttoned, glasses polished. The experiment begins!

Tivon.greeting: I've calculated a 94.3% chance of victory. Shall we test it?
Tivon.trainerLoses: I must have misplaced a decimal point...

Tivon.greeting: Every outcome is a probability. Yours is... unfortunate.
I came straight from Hokulani Observatory. The stars predicted your defeat!

Robyn.greeting: Every battle is research. Let's collect some data, shall we?
Robyn.trainerLoses: This data will require further analysis... a lot of it.

Robyn.greeting: I've recorded three hundred battles this month. You're number three hundred and one.
Robyn.trainerWins: Data point three hundred and one: victory.

Robyn.greeting: My glasses help me spot every weakness. Fogged up yet?
Robyn.trainerWins: Every weakness, spotted! These glasses never lie.
Robyn.trainerLoses: Glasses fogged... I didn't see that coming.

Chucky.greeting: Hiyah! I trained under Kahuna Hala in Iki Town!
Red headband, black belt, unbreakable spirit! Prepare yourself!
Chucky.trainerWins: My spirit holds! The red headband never loses!
Chucky.trainerLoses: My spirit... broken. I'll tie my headband tighter.

Chucky.greeting: I train on the Melemele shore every dawn. Every wave is a punch!
Chucky.trainerWins: A wave of punches! The Melemele shore taught me well!

Iniko.greeting: I train barefoot in the snow on Mount Lanakila! My spirit is unbreakable!
Shoes are a weakness. Feel the ground, feel the battle!
My headband's still wet from the Brooklet Hill waterfalls. Ready!
Iniko.trainerWins: Waterfall strength! Brooklet Hill never fails me!
Iniko.trainerLoses: Swept away... like a leaf in the waterfall.

Arnold.greeting: Five hundred push-ups before breakfast! Five hundred more after! HUP!
I break boards on Big Wave Beach every morning. Today, I break your streak!
Arnold.trainerWins: Broken! Your streak, like a board on Big Wave Beach!

Carrie.greeting: Let's dance! I sway like hula at the Iki Town festival!
Carrie.trainerLoses: I missed a step... I lost the rhythm.

Carrie.greeting: I've danced at every festival in Alola since I was five!
My flower crown is fresh from Malie Garden. Smell that sweet victory!
Carrie.trainerWins: Sweet! My crown smells like victory!

Variel.greeting: Hula tells stories! Today's story ends with me winning!
Variel.trainerWins: What a beautiful story we told!
Variel.trainerLoses: This story didn't end the way I choreographed it.

Variel.greeting: My grandmother taught me every hula from Melemele to Poni. Every one tells a legend!
My dress flows like the waves of Kala'e Bay!
Variel.trainerWins: A flowing victory, like the waves of Kala'e Bay!
Variel.trainerLoses: The wave crashed... right on my dress.

Atalanta.greeting: Feel the beat! I never miss a step!
Atalanta.trainerLoses: Off beat... I lost the rhythm.

Atalanta.greeting: I dance at every luau in Heahea City! Hana hou!
Five, six, seven, eight! Let's go!
Atalanta.trainerLoses: Five, six, seven... I forgot eight.

Harvey.greeting: The Aether Foundation protects Pokémon. But we battle hard, too!
Harvey.trainerWins: Protecting and winning: that's the Aether way!
Harvey.trainerLoses: Your Pokémon are clearly well cared for. Well done.

Harvey.greeting: I rescue injured Pokémon from Alola's storms. I'm braver than I look!
My all-white uniform stays spotless, even in battle. Aether standards!
Harvey.trainerLoses: Stained... Aether's laundry service will be busy.

Luke.greeting: I care for injured Pokémon at Aether Paradise. My team is healthy and strong!
Luke.trainerLoses: Maybe they need a rest back at Aether Paradise.

Luke.greeting: I sing to the Pokémon in the conservation area every night. They love it!
Luke.trainerWins: They love the singing AND the winning!

Luke.greeting: White from head to toe. Aether Paradise style!
Luke.trainerWins: Paradise-perfect! Not a speck on me.
Luke.trainerLoses: Paradise lost... and my uniform's a mess.

Granville.greeting: I've beaten every Trial Captain in Alola. You're next!
Granville.trainerLoses: You're tougher than any Trial Captain I've faced.

Granville.greeting: I finished my island challenge in record time. Now I'm here for more!
Spiky hair, sharp mind. Let's go!
Granville.trainerWins: Sharp as ever! Hair and mind!

Raz.greeting: Strategy beats strength. Let me show you why.
Raz.trainerLoses: Your strategy was a step ahead of mine.

Raz.greeting: I've planned out every possible move you could make. All of them.
Gloves on, plan ready. Strike first, strike hard!
Raz.trainerLoses: Struck back... first isn't always best.

Heidi.greeting: The Aether Foundation preserves habitats. Let's preserve my streak, too!
Heidi.trainerLoses: Looks like my streak is now an endangered species...

Heidi.greeting: I track wild Pokémon across all four islands for Aether. You're a rare sighting!
My white uniform reflects the sun at Aether Paradise. Bright, isn't it?
Heidi.trainerWins: Dazzling! The Aether sun shines on me.
Heidi.trainerLoses: Dimmed... even Aether Paradise feels gloomy.

Haley.greeting: I study Pokémon ecology at Aether Paradise. I know exactly how yours behave!
Haley.trainerLoses: Your Pokémon behaved in ways my studies never covered!

Haley.greeting: I've catalogued every meadow on Melemele. Next up: your weaknesses!
Haley.trainerLoses: Uncatalogued... you're one of a kind.

Haley.greeting: White cap, white coat, white boots. Even my tablet is white!
Haley.trainerWins: A pure victory! White as my uniform.

Lea.greeting: I don't battle for fun. I battle to win.
Lea.trainerWins: As I said, I battle to win.
Lea.trainerLoses: I came to win... maybe I should learn to have fun too.

Lea.greeting: Fun is for after. Right now, it's business.
My visor keeps my eyes on the prize. That's you.
Lea.trainerLoses: Prize lost... my visor didn't help.

Sylvia.greeting: I've analyzed every kind of Trainer there is. You can't surprise me!
Classic Alolan Trainer: big smile, bigger confidence. I've seen it all.
Pointing is rude, but I'm pointing at the winner: me!

Stein.greeting: My latest invention is a battle plan optimized for this exact moment!
Stein.trainerLoses: Back to the lab for some adjustments...

Stein.greeting: I invented a self-stirring cocoa mug. Next invention: victory!
I've read every paper Aether Paradise ever published. Your moves are in my notes already.
Stein.trainerWins: Exactly as noted! My research is flawless.

Cadel.greeting: Science explains everything, especially why I'm about to win!
Cadel.trainerLoses: Science cannot explain how you did that...

Cadel.greeting: Gravity, magnetism, thermodynamics... and now, battle science!
Lab coat, tie, clipboard. I'm dressed for a breakthrough!
Cadel.trainerWins: Breakthrough! I'll publish this right away.
Cadel.trainerLoses: Breakdown... my clipboard's flying off the tree.

Boris.greeting: Ten thousand punches a day! Can you withstand them all?
Boris.trainerLoses: I should try twenty thousand tomorrow...

Boris.greeting: My fists are as hard as the cliffs of Ula'ula!
I train on the ridge at Wela Volcano Park. Heat forges discipline!
Boris.trainerWins: Forged in fire! The heat made me unbreakable!

Bryson.greeting: I meditated on Mount Lanakila for a week. My mind is clear!
Bryson.trainerWins: A clear mind leads to victory!
Bryson.trainerLoses: My mind is cloudy now... I must meditate again.

Bryson.greeting: Barefoot, belted, bowing. Silence before the storm.
Bryson.trainerWins: The storm has passed. I stand.

Jo.greeting: I've danced on every stage in Alola. This is my grandest yet!
Spotlight on me, please! I'm ready for my big moment!
My flower crown came from Akala's meadows. Every petal is a dance step!
Jo.trainerLoses: Petals scattered... my crown's falling apart.

Tasanee.greeting: Let's put on a show! The crowd deserves something spectacular!
Tasanee.trainerLoses: The show's over... and you stole it.

Tasanee.greeting: Sequins, feathers and flowers. I never perform without all three!
Tasanee.trainerLoses: Lost a feather... and the show.

Tasanee.greeting: I perform at the Hano Grand Resort luau every night. Tonight, I perform for you!
Tasanee.trainerWins: Bravo! The luau crowd would be on their feet!

Levi.greeting: I've climbed this tree more times than I can count. You won't stop me.
Levi.trainerWins: Like I said, no one stops me.
Levi.trainerLoses: I'll have to start counting from zero again.

Levi.greeting: Climb number... five hundred and something. Who's counting? Me. I'm counting.
My gloves are worn out from all these climbs. Still got a grip on victory!

Hashim.greeting: Elite Trainers don't make mistakes. Let's begin.
Hashim.trainerLoses: One mistake... that's all it took.

Hashim.greeting: My jacket has seen Vast Poni Canyon and the peak of Lanakila. I've seen everything.
Hashim.trainerWins: Seen it all, and won it all!

Hashim.greeting: Perfection is a habit. So is winning.

Munin.greeting: I've been watching your battles. I know exactly what you'll do next.
Munin.trainerLoses: I didn't see that coming at all...

Munin.greeting: I study every challenger before they reach the top. You're no different.
Gloves on, focus sharp. Let's settle this.
Munin.trainerLoses: Unsettled... I didn't see that one coming.

Poppy.greeting: Every battle is a chance to grow. Let's both get stronger today!
Poppy.trainerWins: I grew a little today. Did you?
Poppy.trainerLoses: You helped me grow a lot today. Thank you!

Poppy.greeting: I write down one thing I learn from every opponent. What will you teach me?
Poppy.trainerLoses: Lesson for me today... a big one.

Poppy.greeting: Light-blue visor, bright smile. I like to keep things positive!

Tamah.greeting: I jog to the Battle Tree from Seafolk Village every morning. Endurance is everything!
Tamah.trainerWins: Endurance wins! Those Seafolk jogs pay off!
Tamah.trainerLoses: Out of breath... I'll jog twice tomorrow.

Tamah.greeting: I've trained day and night to reach this height. I won't fall now!
Tamah.trainerLoses: I've fallen... but I'll climb right back up.

Tamah.greeting: Marathons on Melemele, hill runs on Akala. I never stop moving!

Bette.greeting: I'm here for one thing only: crushing win streaks.
I keep a list of every streak I've ended. Yours is next.

Bette.trainerLoses: Blunted... my visor's not so sharp today.

Kikujiro.greeting: I've been battling since before you were born. Let me teach you a thing or two.
Kikujiro.trainerWins: That's lesson one. Come back for lesson two.
Kikujiro.trainerLoses: Heh. Seems you've got a thing or two to teach me.

Kikujiro.greeting: This jacket has seen forty years of battles. Not a single tear in it.
Back in my day, we climbed the Battle Tree uphill. Both ways.
Kikujiro.trainerWins: Uphill both ways, and still winning!

Xenophon.greeting: Decades of battles have taught me one thing: never underestimate anyone.
Xenophon.trainerWins: I didn't underestimate you, and that's why I won.
Xenophon.trainerLoses: And still I underestimated you. Remarkable.

Xenophon.greeting: I respect every opponent, young or old. Show me your respect, too.
My hair hangs long like jungle vines. I've lived in the Lush Jungle for twenty years.

Placido.greeting: My Pokémon and I have grown old together. We still have plenty of fight left!
Placido.trainerLoses: Perhaps our fight is winding down after all...

Placido.greeting: I've traveled far in this jacket. Farther than you'd think.
Placido.trainerLoses: A long way home in this old jacket...

Placido.greeting: Old age is just experience with a few more wrinkles!

Ignacio.greeting: I've traveled every region. Alola's Trainers are the toughest yet. Show me why.
Ignacio.trainerWins: Not quite the toughest yet. Keep at it.
Ignacio.trainerLoses: Yes, the toughest yet. You've proven it.

Ignacio.greeting: I've sailed across every sea to reach this island. The journey was worth it.
My beard went gray from a lifetime of battles. One more won't hurt.
Ignacio.trainerWins: Still kicking! The gray beard's got some fight left!

Aino.greeting: Experience is my greatest weapon. Do you have enough to match it?
Aino.trainerLoses: You have experience beyond your years.

Aino.greeting: I meditate at the Ruins of Life on Akala. My mind is calm, my will is strong.
I read people like books. You're an easy read.

Xio.greeting: I've seen countless Trainers rise and fall. Which will you be?
Xio.trainerWins: Fallen, I'm afraid. But you can rise again.
Xio.trainerLoses: You're rising. I can see it clearly now.

Xio.greeting: Every Trainer is a story. Let's see how yours ends.
My gloves have held a thousand Poké Balls. Let's see what yours can do.

Priya.greeting: In my day, we battled with heart. Let's see yours.
Priya.trainerWins: Your heart is strong, but not yet strong enough.
Priya.trainerLoses: Now that's a heart worth seeing.

Priya.greeting: Short hair, sturdy gloves, no nonsense. I'm practical.
Heart, grit and good boots. That's all a Trainer needs.

Candy.greeting: I treat battles like cooking: season well and serve hot. Ready for a taste?
Candy.trainerLoses: It seems your seasoning was even better.

Candy.greeting: I've hiked Lanakila in these boots and gloves. A battle won't wear them out!
Candy.trainerWins: Durable! My boots and my will, still standing.
Candy.trainerLoses: Worn out... even these boots have their limits.

Candy.greeting: A pinch of patience, a dash of daring. That's my secret recipe!
Candy.trainerLoses: Too much daring, not enough patience...

Napoleon.greeting: Attention! General Napoleon has arrived! I've planned this battle down to the last step!
Napoleon.trainerWins: Victory, precisely as the general planned!
Napoleon.trainerLoses: Retreat! The general must reconsider his strategy...

Napoleon.greeting: Laugh at my shorts all you like. Great generals come in small sizes!
Napoleon.trainerWins: Not so funny now, is it? Small general, big win!
Napoleon.trainerLoses: Even great generals lose a battle. I'll win the war!

Napoleon.greeting: I drew a map of this whole tree in crayon. Every branch is part of my plan!
Napoleon.trainerLoses: My map didn't have YOU on it...

Brady.greeting: You know who I am, right? Everyone on Poni Island knows Brady!
Brady.trainerWins: Now you'll remember the name! Brady!
Brady.trainerLoses: Okay, now everyone will know me as the kid who lost...

Brady.greeting: I've signed autographs at the Pokémon Center café. Want one before or after I win?
Brady.trainerWins: After, then! Here you go: To my biggest fan!

Brady.greeting: A kid in board shorts this famous? Pretty cool, huh?
Brady.trainerWins: Famous AND undefeated! Well, today, anyway.
Brady.trainerLoses: Famous for losing... that's not the kind I wanted.

Samantha.greeting: I may look sweet, but my battle record is anything but!
Samantha.trainerWins: Sweet look, sour result for you!

Samantha.greeting: People see my flower clip and think I'm harmless. Their mistake!
Samantha.trainerLoses: I guess I'm the one who made the mistake today.

Samantha.greeting: I'm the toughest Lass on all four islands. Ask anyone in Konikoni!

Inez.greeting: Everyone thinks a Lass in a skirt is easy. I'd like a word with everyone!
Inez.trainerWins: Underestimated again. Thanks for the win!
Inez.trainerLoses: This time I'm the one who underestimated you.

Inez.greeting: My twin sister always beats me at everything. Not today!
Inez.trainerLoses: Please don't tell my twin about this...

Inez.greeting: I chased my sister up Lanakila once. Now I'm chasing wins up this tree!
Inez.trainerWins: Worth every step of the chase!
Inez.trainerLoses: Back to chasing... I need longer legs.

Niara.greeting: Professor Kukui let me hold a Poké Ball once! I'm basically a professor now!
Niara.trainerLoses: Professor Niara needs to study more...

Niara.greeting: Why is the sky blue? Why is the sea salty? Why are you about to lose? I know everything!
Niara.trainerWins: I knew it! I know everything!
Niara.trainerLoses: Why... did I lose? I don't know everything...

Niara.greeting: When I'm eleven, I'm doing the island challenge! This is practice!
Niara.trainerLoses: Maybe I'll wait a few more years...

Victor.greeting: My name means 'winner'! It's my superhero name AND my real name!
Victor.trainerWins: Winner, just like my name says!
Victor.trainerLoses: Maybe I need a new superhero name...

Victor.greeting: My sun hat is my superhero mask! Okay, it's a hat. But it's super!
Victor.trainerLoses: My super hat lost its powers...

Victor.greeting: Superheroes always win in the end! Watch me save the day!
Victor.trainerWins: The day is saved! Thank you, citizens!

Reina.greeting: My Pokémon are my best friends! Best friends always win together!
Reina.trainerLoses: It's okay. Best friends lose together too.

Reina.greeting: I made friendship bracelets for my whole team! Want one after I win?
Reina.trainerWins: Here's your bracelet! We're friends now!
Reina.trainerLoses: Can I still give you a bracelet? You won it.

Reina.greeting: I'm gonna be the first Alola League Champion from my preschool!
Reina.trainerLoses: Champions practice even when they lose!

Naya.greeting: Last night I dreamed I won a battle up here! Dreams come true, right?
Naya.trainerLoses: Maybe it was a different dream...

Naya.greeting: I wanna fly over Poni Island someday, way up in the clouds!
Naya.trainerWins: I'm flying! Well, my heart is!
Naya.trainerLoses: Back down to the ground... for now.

Naya.greeting: Mommy reads me stories about heroes every night. Tonight, the story is about me!
Naya.trainerLoses: Tonight's story has a sad part...

Gwenny.greeting: I've backpacked across every region. Alola's the last stop on my list!
Gwenny.trainerWins: What a way to finish the journey!
Gwenny.trainerLoses: Looks like my journey isn't over just yet.

Gwenny.greeting: My backpack has patches from every region I've visited. Alola's patch goes on today!
Gwenny.trainerWins: Sewing on the Alola patch tonight!
Gwenny.trainerLoses: No patch yet... I'll have to stay a while.

Gwenny.greeting: My backpack's full of trail mix and maps from every region. All I need now is a win.
Gwenny.trainerLoses: I'll just eat my trail mix sadly...

Fernanda.greeting: I camp under the stars on the Poni Plains every night. They're brighter than anywhere!
Fernanda.trainerWins: The stars are smiling on me tonight!
Fernanda.trainerLoses: No stars for me tonight. Just clouds.

Fernanda.greeting: I've named a star after every battle I've won. I'm running out of names!
Fernanda.trainerWins: Another star in the sky for me!

Fernanda.greeting: Thumbs up! My boots have walked from the Haina Desert to Seafolk Village!
Fernanda.trainerLoses: My boots need a rest. So do I.

Vivek.greeting: Forty years guiding hikers through Poni's trails. This tree is just another trail to me!
Vivek.trainerLoses: This trail sent me tumbling down a cliff...

Vivek.greeting: Stay on the path, drink plenty of water, and don't underestimate the old guide!
Vivek.trainerWins: Rule three: don't underestimate the old guide!
Vivek.trainerLoses: Looks like I broke my own rule three...

Vivek.greeting: I've led a thousand hikers up Vast Poni Canyon. None of them beat me in battle!
Vivek.trainerLoses: Well, now one of them has.

Stellan.greeting: I've survived Lanakila blizzards in a tank top. A little battle won't faze me!
Jackets are for quitters! I climb in a tank top all year round!
Stellan.trainerWins: No jacket needed for this win!
Stellan.trainerLoses: Maybe I should've brought a jacket...

Stellan.greeting: My boots are worn from the Ancient Poni Path. They'll carry me through this too!

Savir.greeting: Three promotions this year. You're my next big project, and I deliver results.
Savir.trainerLoses: This project needs a total restructure.

Savir.greeting: I keep a Poké Ball in my shirt pocket next to my pen. Both are always ready.
Savir.trainerLoses: My pen's out of ink. My team's out of steam.

Savir.greeting: Corner office by the Malie waterfront, here I come. Right after this battle.
Savir.trainerWins: One step closer to that corner office!

Harding.greeting: I fly to Konikoni City for deals every week. This battle is my easiest contract yet.
Harding.trainerWins: Contract signed, sealed and delivered. Pleasure doing business.

Harding.greeting: Tie straight, shoes polished, Pokémon trained. Professionalism wins.
Harding.trainerLoses: Unprofessional of me to lose like that.

Harding.greeting: Firm handshake, strong eye contact. That's how you close a deal. And a battle.

Darrel.greeting: I manage fifty people at the Malie City office. Six Pokémon? Easy!
Darrel.trainerLoses: I'll need to call a team meeting about this...

Darrel.greeting: Let's circle back after I win. I'll send a summary email.
Darrel.trainerWins: Summary: I won. Email to follow.
Darrel.trainerLoses: Summary: I lost. No email necessary.

Darrel.greeting: I keep my hair short so it never gets in the way of a good battle!
Darrel.trainerLoses: Something got in my way: you.

Jana.greeting: My calendar is full, but I always pencil in a battle on Poni Island!
Jana.trainerWins: Time well spent! Penciling in another battle for next week.
Jana.trainerLoses: Should've spent that time at the office...

Jana.greeting: I did my shopping at the Royal Avenue Megamart. Last item on my list: a win!
Jana.trainerLoses: Out of stock on wins today...

Jana.greeting: Errands, meetings, battles: I juggle it all and never drop a thing!

Etta.greeting: I can stare down anybody. I won a staring contest against a statue once!
Etta.trainerWins: Stared you down! You blinked first!

Etta.greeting: I've beaten every punk on Ula'ula Island. You're just small fry!
One look from me and you'll wanna run home to your mom!
Etta.trainerWins: Shoulda run when you had the chance!

Dustin.greeting: Respect's earned on Ula'ula, kid. Let's see if you've got what it takes.
Dustin.trainerWins: Didn't earn it today. Ula'ula respect stays with my crew.

Dustin.greeting: I watch every Battle Royal from the cheap seats. Time to step into the ring!
Dustin.trainerWins: Heel turn complete! The crowd goes wild... or boos. Same thing.

Dustin.greeting: Tank top, shorts, no fear. That's how we roll in Po Town.
Dustin.trainerWins: No fear, all win! That's the Po Town way.
Dustin.trainerLoses: Okay, maybe a little fear now.

Zed.greeting: I ran Route 15's back alleys for years. This tree's my new turf!
Zed.trainerWins: My turf, my rules! Route 15 would be proud.
Zed.trainerLoses: Fine. Take the turf. I'll find another.

Zed.greeting: Everybody in Po Town knows not to mess with Zed. Now you'll know too.
Zed.trainerWins: Now you know! Spread the word.
Zed.trainerLoses: Okay, YOU can mess with Zed. Just you.

Zed.greeting: Pink hair, don't care! Let's make this loud!

Edda.greeting: Think you're tough? I've got scars from battles tougher than you.
Edda.trainerWins: Not even a scratch this time.
Edda.trainerLoses: Guess I'll be adding another scar...

Edda.greeting: I hang out in the abandoned Megamart after dark. Nothing scares me.
Edda.trainerWins: Spooked ya! The Megamart's got nothing on me.

Edda.greeting: Black top, white cap, cold stare. Everything about me says 'stay back'!

Leena.greeting: Speed is everything! I'm the fastest base runner in Hau'oli!
Leena.trainerWins: Too fast for you! Safe at home!
Leena.trainerLoses: Thrown out at home... you were faster.

Leena.greeting: I'm training for the big island games. You're my last warm-up!
Leena.trainerLoses: Guess I'm not ready for the games yet...

Leena.greeting: Swing first, think later! That's my whole strategy!

Buddy.greeting: Coach says I'm the toughest on the team. And the fastest!
Buddy.trainerLoses: Coach is gonna make me run extra laps...

Buddy.greeting: Team first, me second! But today it's just me, so me first!
Buddy.trainerWins: Me first! Team would be proud!

Buddy.greeting: I swing this bat a hundred times every morning in Hau'oli. Batter up!
Buddy.trainerWins: Grand slam! Bases loaded, battle over!
Buddy.trainerLoses: The bat's cracked. So am I.

Hilario.greeting: I never skip leg day. Never. Ever.
Hilario.trainerWins: Leg day pays off! Never skip it!
Hilario.trainerLoses: Maybe I need an extra leg day...

Hilario.greeting: I race the sunset on Route 1 every evening. I haven't lost yet!
Hilario.trainerWins: Still undefeated! The sunset can't catch me!

Hilario.greeting: Squats at dawn, sprints at noon, battles at sunset. That's my schedule!

Thamina.greeting: I swim out to the Melemele Sea buoys every morning. Can you keep up?
Thamina.trainerLoses: Out-swum... and I thought I was fast in the water.

Thamina.greeting: Gold medal in swimming last year. This year, I'm going for gold in battling!
Tennis racket in one hand, goggles in the other. I'm ready for anything!
Thamina.trainerWins: Won the rally! You couldn't return a single shot!
Thamina.trainerLoses: Lost the rally... you hit back every time.

Dolly.greeting: My fans are watching! I can't disappoint them!
Dolly.trainerWins: Thank you, thank you! My fans are the best!
Dolly.trainerLoses: Sorry, fans... I'll make it up to you.

Dolly.greeting: I sing on the Malie City stage every weekend! Battling is just another performance!
Green shirt, big smile. I'm the star of Malie City!
Dolly.trainerWins: The star of Malie shines on!

Erix.greeting: I've been called a prodigy since I was six. Let's see if it's true!
I learned to read at three, battle at five, and win at six. Ready?
Erix.trainerWins: Still winning, just like at six!

Erix.greeting: I've skipped two grades at the Trainers' School. Let's skip to the part where I win!

Joaquin.greeting: I braid my hair before every battle for luck. Today it's extra tight!
Everyone's my rival. You're my rival now too. Get ready!
Joaquin.trainerLoses: Okay, you're my TOP rival now.

Joaquin.greeting: My star's rising faster than the clouds over Malie!
Joaquin.trainerWins: Still rising! Malie's clouds can't keep up!
Joaquin.trainerLoses: You're rising even faster than me...

Marianne.greeting: I'm going to be the youngest Battle Legend ever. Starting now!
Marianne.trainerLoses: Legends need patience. I'll get there.

Marianne.greeting: I've written my Battle Legend acceptance speech. Want to hear it after I win?
Marianne.trainerWins: 'I'd like to thank... me!' Speech time!
Marianne.trainerLoses: I'll save the speech for later...

Marianne.greeting: Battle Legends never look nervous. See? Calm. Totally calm.

Alice.greeting: I watched Wela Volcano smoke from up close. I live for thrills!
Alice.trainerWins: What a thrill! My heart's still racing!
Alice.trainerLoses: Too thrilling... I need to lie down.

Alice.greeting: Skydiving over Melemele, cliff jumping on Akala... and now, the Battle Tree!
Camera charged, cap on, and my sightseeing day ends with a win!
Alice.trainerLoses: Not the ending I planned for my trip...

Chen.greeting: I always battle the best Trainer wherever I travel. That's you, isn't it?
Chen.trainerWins: Maybe I should look for the best Trainer somewhere else...
Chen.trainerLoses: Yes, definitely the best one here. What a trip!

Chen.greeting: Each country, one battle, one souvenir photo. Smile!
Chen.trainerLoses: Souvenir photo of a loss... still a memory.

Chen.greeting: I've battled on every continent. Alola has the best view by far!

Christian.greeting: I paint the view from every island. Today I'll paint my own victory!
Christian.trainerLoses: My painting needs a sadder color...

Christian.greeting: The view from Poni's cliffs is gorgeous. Let's make this battle just as beautiful!
Christian.trainerLoses: The view's still lovely, at least.

Christian.greeting: My sun hat's wide enough to shade my easel AND me. Let's paint!

Ezra.greeting: I travel the islands to battle strong Trainers. Please be strong!
Ezra.trainerWins: Not quite strong enough... the search goes on.
Ezra.trainerLoses: Yes! You're exactly the strong Trainer I was looking for!

Ezra.greeting: I watched the sunset from Mount Hokulani last night. Today, I'll watch you fall!
Ezra.trainerLoses: The sun set on me this time...

Ezra.greeting: I keep a journal of every strong Trainer I meet. Make your entry a good one!

Sika.greeting: I've cleaned this whole tree from top to bottom. I know every inch of it!
Sika.trainerLoses: You know this place better than I do...

Sika.greeting: Third step from the top creaks. Fifth window sticks. I know this tree like family.
These coveralls are stain-proof, sun-proof and loss-proof. Let's get messy!
Sika.trainerWins: Still spotless! Not one drop on me.
Sika.trainerLoses: There's a stain I'll never get out...

Paulo.greeting: A clean floor and a clean battle. That's how I like it.
Paulo.trainerWins: Spotless! Not a scuff on the floor or the battle.
Paulo.trainerLoses: This is one stain I can't scrub out...

Paulo.greeting: I wash my hands twenty times a day. Clean hands, clean win!
Paulo.trainerLoses: Time to wash my hands of this...

Paulo.greeting: I clean the Pokémon Center here, too. Your team will need it after this!
Paulo.trainerLoses: I'll be using it myself, I think...

Dan.greeting: I've built bridges across Alola. A win streak is just another bridge!
Every bridge I build lasts a hundred years. So will this win!
Dan.trainerWins: Built to last a hundred years!
Dan.trainerLoses: This one didn't last a minute...

Dan.greeting: Knee pads, hard hat, gloves. I'm geared up!
Dan.trainerWins: The gear works! Safety AND victory!
Dan.trainerLoses: My gear's busted... and so is my streak.

Omar.greeting: Hard work pays off. Let's see whose work pays more today!
Omar.trainerWins: My hard work wins this round!

Omar.greeting: I helped build the stairs up to the Battle Tree. Climb 'em okay?
Omar.trainerWins: Built to last, like those stairs!

Omar.greeting: Up at four, work till six, battle till sundown. That's my day!

Mechabob.greeting: Ah, a worthy challenger at last. Let us battle as gentlemen do.
Mechabob.trainerWins: A gentleman's victory. Thank you for the match.
Mechabob.trainerLoses: I would tip my hat to you, if I wore one.

Mechabob.greeting: I collect seashells from every beach in Alola. Each one tells a story. So will this battle.
Mechabob.trainerWins: A story with a happy ending!
Mechabob.trainerLoses: A story with a twist... for me.

Mechabob.greeting: This shirt has hibiscus on it. Lovely flowers. Lovely battles.
Mechabob.trainerLoses: Less lovely now... even the hibiscus is drooping.

Abel.greeting: I've battled in the finest establishments in the world. This tree is quite charming.
Abel.trainerWins: A charming victory to end the day.
Abel.trainerLoses: Charming tree, charming defeat. Most memorable.

Abel.greeting: My passport has stamps from forty countries. Alola has the finest sunsets of them all.
Abel.trainerWins: A fine sunset for a fine win!
Abel.trainerLoses: Even the finest sunset can't brighten this...

Abel.greeting: My beard took forty years to grow. My battling took fifty to perfect.

Donny.greeting: Darling, I'm throwing a victory party tonight. You're invited... to watch.
My parties at my Malie estate are legendary. So is my battling, darling.
Donny.trainerLoses: Not my most legendary evening, I'm afraid.

Donny.greeting: Champagne on ice, music on the lanai. All I need now is a win, darling.
Donny.trainerLoses: Put the champagne back on ice...

Gracie.greeting: I simply adore battling. Shall we make this delightful?
Gracie.trainerLoses: Not delightful at all... for me, anyway.

Gracie.greeting: I adore the beach, I adore the sunsets, and I simply adore winning!
Gracie.trainerLoses: I don't adore this at all...

Gracie.greeting: My green dress matches the jungle, darling. My temper matches the volcano.
Gracie.trainerWins: Ferocious! I'm in a lovely mood now.
Gracie.trainerLoses: Temper, temper... I'm afraid I've lost mine.

Donna.greeting: I've served the finest guests in Alola. Allow me to serve you a defeat!
Donna.trainerWins: Your defeat, served with a smile!
Donna.trainerLoses: It seems you're the one who served me.

Donna.greeting: Fresh towels, chilled drinks and a battle, served promptly!
I bow to every guest. Please bow back after you lose!

Gilroy.greeting: Room service! One battle, extra tough, coming right up!
Gilroy.trainerWins: Order delivered! Extra tough, as requested.
Gilroy.trainerLoses: I think I mixed up the order...

Gilroy.greeting: My slicked-back hair survives the Poni winds. Nothing ruffles me!
Gilroy.trainerWins: Unshaken! Not a hair out of place.
Gilroy.trainerLoses: My hair's a mess. So's my battle.

Gilroy.greeting: Check-in at three, battle at four, victory by five. Right on schedule!
Gilroy.trainerWins: Checked in! Enjoy your stay in the loser's suite.

Patrick.greeting: Lowest handicap at my golf club in Hau'oli. Let's see yours!
Patrick.trainerLoses: My handicap just went way up...

Patrick.greeting: Did I mention my handicap? It's very low. Extremely low.
Mid-swing is my best pose. Keep your eye on the ball!
Patrick.trainerLoses: Shanked it... right into the ocean.

Moe.greeting: One swing. That's all I need.

Bruce.greeting: I hit the green every time. Every. Single. Time.
Bruce.trainerWins: On the green again! Never misses!

Bruce.greeting: I haven't missed a fairway since I was twelve. Not starting now!
Bruce.trainerLoses: First miss since I was twelve...

Bruce.greeting: Red polo, red visor, red-hot swing! Fore!
Bruce.trainerWins: Fore, and done! Red-hot swing, red-hot win!
Bruce.trainerLoses: Foul ball... my red-hot swing cooled off.

Susanna.greeting: Golf is a gentle sport. Battling... is not!
Susanna.trainerLoses: I'll stick to gentle sports for a while...

Susanna.greeting: I teach golf at the Hano Grand Resort. Lesson one: never underestimate me.
Susanna.trainerWins: Lesson learned! Never underestimate the instructor.

Susanna.greeting: Keep your head down, follow through, and never give up. That's my lesson for today!
Susanna.trainerLoses: I forgot to follow my own advice...

Lori.greeting: My Pokémon are raised perfectly. I made sure of it.
I keep a notebook on every meal, every nap and every training session. Perfection!
I brush every Pokémon at dawn, before the Paniola cattle wake up.

Colby.greeting: Raising Pokémon is an art. Let me show you my masterpiece!
Colby.trainerLoses: My masterpiece needs a few more brushstrokes...

Colby.greeting: Every Pokémon I raise is a work of art. This team is my gallery!
This glove has handled a thousand Eggs. Every one hatched a winner!
Colby.trainerWins: Another winner! This glove's never wrong.
Colby.trainerLoses: Not this one... even my glove's surprised.

Danby.greeting: Born and raised on Paniola Ranch! Alola's in my bones!
Danby.trainerWins: Alolan pride! Born and raised strong!

Danby.greeting: Slow and steady wins the race. That's what the ranch taught me!
My braids, my hat, my ranch. My Pokémon love it there, and you'll see why!
Danby.trainerWins: Ranch strength! Now you see why they love it there.

Izel.greeting: I've raised champions before. This team is my finest work!
Izel.trainerLoses: Perhaps not my finest after all...

Izel.greeting: Three of my Pokémon won ribbons at the Hau'oli fair. This one will win you!
Izel.trainerWins: Blue ribbon, just like the Hau'oli fair!

Izel.greeting: Raised with care, trained with love. That's the Izel way!
Izel.trainerLoses: The Izel way needs a new chapter...

Presta.greeting: When the alarm rings, I'm ready. And it's ringing now!
Presta.trainerLoses: False alarm... for my victory, anyway.

Presta.greeting: I sleep in my boots. You never know when the call will come!
Presta.trainerLoses: Should've taken my boots off and rested...

Presta.greeting: Yellow stripes, so you can see me through the smoke. You'll see me win, too.
Presta.trainerWins: Clear as day! Those stripes never lie.
