Calder.greeting: I've walked through flames to rescue Pokémon. This battle is nothing!
Calder.trainerWins: Through the flames and out the other side!
Calder.trainerLoses: Those were flames I couldn't walk through...

Calder.greeting: I've carried hikers down Vast Poni Canyon on my back. I don't give up!
Calder.trainerLoses: Okay... I'll give up. Just this once.

Calder.greeting: I watch Akala's dry hills for brush fires. Today, I'm putting out your streak!
Calder.trainerWins: Extinguished! Akala's hills are safe from your streak.

Larry.greeting: My recipes have won awards all over Alola. Time for another!
Larry.trainerLoses: Not every recipe can be a winner...

Larry.greeting: Kalua pig needs a good fire pit and twelve hours of patience. I have both!
My apron's clean, but not for long. Let's make a mess!
Larry.trainerWins: A delicious mess! My apron's ruined, but who cares?

Tony.greeting: Prepare yourself for a five-course battle!
Tony.trainerLoses: I couldn't even get past the appetizer...

Tony.greeting: Haupia for dessert, but first, the main course: you!
Every plate is a work of art. Every battle, too!

Sam.greeting: I've collected treasures from every corner of the world. Only the best made it to Alola!
Sam.trainerWins: Only the best, as I said!
Sam.trainerLoses: Perhaps I'll add you to my collection of rivals.

Sam.greeting: My collection has its own room in my house. Two rooms, actually. Three.
I appraise everything I see. You? Rare, but not priceless.

Dennis.greeting: I spent a whole year searching Alola for one rare treasure. Worth it!
My collection holds the rarest treasures around. Prepare to be amazed!
Dennis.trainerLoses: You're even rarer than my treasures...

Dennis.greeting: I keep my hair neat and my treasures polished. A collector's habit.

Horace.greeting: I've been at the top of this tree for years. I don't plan on stepping down.
Horace.trainerWins: The top is where I belong.
Horace.trainerLoses: Maybe it's time for someone new at the top.

Horace.greeting: The view from the top never gets old. Neither does winning.
Horace.trainerLoses: The view looks different from down here...

Horace.greeting: I've turned away a thousand challengers. You'll be a thousand and one.

Perri.greeting: I've healed thousands of Pokémon at the Poni Pokémon Center. I know how strong they get!
Perri.trainerWins: Shall I heal your Pokémon for you? They've earned a rest.
Perri.trainerLoses: Now my own team needs healing. Come back anytime!

Perri.greeting: Pink dress, white apron, and a battle face. Surprised?
Rest well, eat well, battle well! That's the Pokémon Center way!
Perri.trainerLoses: Time to take my own advice and rest...

Dooley.greeting: I've battled Champions and Legends. You'll have to be something special.
Dooley.trainerLoses: Something special indeed. The future's in good hands.

Dooley.greeting: I've stood across from Champions in every region. You don't scare me.
This leather jacket is older than the Alola League. So is my experience.
Dooley.trainerWins: Experience wins! Older than the League, and still winning.
Dooley.trainerLoses: You're in a league of your own...

Demiathena.greeting: My name is known in every battle hall in the world. Have you heard it?
Demiathena.trainerLoses: I'll be sure to remember your name, too.

Demiathena.greeting: I watched the Alola League open from the front row. Now I'm making history here.
Demiathena.trainerWins: History made! Front row to my own victory!

Red.trainerWins: … (Red tugs his cap down and turns back to the view.)
Red.trainerLoses: … (Red smiles faintly and gives you a nod.)

Red.greeting: … (Red pulls his cap low. His eyes don't leave you, not even for a second.)
Red.trainerWins: … (Red lifts his cap just enough to meet your eyes, then looks away.)
Red.trainerLoses: … (Red pushes his cap back and, for the first time, looks impressed.)

Red.greeting: … (The sea breeze off Poni Island tugs at Red's cap. He doesn't notice. He's watching you.)
Red.trainerWins: … (Red settles his cap against the breeze and looks back out to sea.)
Red.trainerLoses: … (The breeze finally lifts Red's cap. He catches it, and, for once, he grins.)

Blue.greeting: So you're the one everybody's talking about? I'm the strongest Trainer around, so this'll be quick!
Blue.trainerWins: Ha! Told you I'm the strongest. Come back when you've grown up a bit!
Blue.trainerLoses: What?! Me, lose? ...Fine. Maybe I'm only the second strongest.

Blue.greeting: Alola's sea breeze is nice and all, but I didn't come for the view. I came to show who's the best!
Blue.trainerWins: Showed 'em! Enjoy the view on your way down.
Blue.trainerLoses: Tch. Fine, you can have the view. ...And the win.

Blue.greeting: I was Champion once, you know. For about five minutes. Don't you dare make this worse!
Blue.trainerLoses: Great. Now I've got two short reigns to live down.

Grimsley.greeting: Life is a gamble, and a battle is the finest bet of all. Shall we roll the dice?
Grimsley.trainerWins: The dice favored me today. Fortune is fickle, so try your luck again.
Grimsley.trainerLoses: I bet everything and lost. Ah, but what a thrilling gamble it was.

Grimsley.greeting: Alola's sunshine suits a gambler. Every day is a fresh deal. Shall we see what we're dealt?
Grimsley.trainerWins: A winning hand. The Alolan sun smiles on me today.
Grimsley.trainerLoses: You were dealt the better hand. I fold, gracefully.

Grimsley.greeting: I wager everything on every battle: my pride, my reputation... and my lunch money.
Grimsley.trainerWins: The wager pays out handsomely. Lunch is on me today.
Grimsley.trainerLoses: Lost the wager... and my lunch money. Worth it.

Anabel.greeting: I can sense the bond between a Trainer and their Pokémon. Yours is strong... let's see how strong.
Anabel.trainerWins: Your bond is strong, but mine was stronger today.
Anabel.trainerLoses: Your bond is even stronger than I sensed. Remarkable.

Anabel.greeting: Looker sends his regards. International Police work is tiring, so a battle makes a nice change of pace.
Anabel.trainerWins: A refreshing change. I'll tell Looker you put up a good fight.
Anabel.trainerLoses: Looker will be surprised I lost. Don't tell him I enjoyed it.

Anabel.greeting: I was a Frontier Brain once. The Battle Tree feels like home. Show me your best.
Anabel.trainerWins: Just like the old Battle Frontier days. Your team has heart, but not enough yet.
Anabel.trainerLoses: You'd have made a fine Battle Frontier challenger. Splendid.

Wally.greeting: I used to be too frail to even leave home. Now look how far my Pokémon have taken me!
Wally.trainerWins: We've come so far together. You'll get there too!
Wally.trainerLoses: Still so much further to go... but I'll keep climbing!

Wally.greeting: I trained all the way from Hoenn for this. I'm not that shy kid anymore!
Wally.trainerWins: See? Not the shy kid anymore. Thank you for battling me!
Wally.trainerLoses: Still not shy... just beaten. I'll keep training!

Wally.greeting: The ocean air in Alola is so good for my health. I feel strong enough to win!
Wally.trainerWins: The ocean air worked! I've never felt better!
Wally.trainerLoses: I feel great even after losing. Alola really is good for me.

Colress.greeting: I'm researching how to draw out a Pokémon's full potential. You'll make a fine test subject.
Colress.trainerWins: Fascinating. Your potential has limits... for now.
Colress.trainerLoses: Marvelous! You've drawn out potential beyond my calculations!

Colress.greeting: Alola's Z-Power fascinates me. Let's measure how much power your bond with your Pokémon holds.
Colress.trainerWins: Data collected. Your bond is strong, but my readings say mine is stronger.
Colress.trainerLoses: Remarkable readings! Your bond overloaded my instruments!

Colress.greeting: My goggles record everything. Let's see what discoveries this battle holds!
Colress.trainerWins: Recorded: you have room to grow!

Cynthia.greeting: I came to Alola to study its legends. A battle with you might be worth studying too.
Cynthia.trainerWins: A good battle, though not quite a legendary one. Keep growing.
Cynthia.trainerLoses: That was a legendary battle. I'll remember it alongside the old stories.

Cynthia.greeting: Alola's shave ice might be the best dessert I've ever had. Let's battle before it melts!
Cynthia.trainerWins: Just in time. My shave ice is still cold.
Cynthia.trainerLoses: It melted while we battled... but it was worth it.

Cynthia.greeting: My coat is a bit warm for Alola, but I'd never battle without it.
Cynthia.trainerWins: Worth the heat. Come back when you're ready for more.
Cynthia.trainerLoses: I may need a lighter coat... and a lesson from you.

Plumeria.greeting: So you're the kid giving my grunts so much trouble? Time somebody taught you some manners.
Plumeria.trainerWins: Manners taught. Now run along, kid.
Plumeria.trainerLoses: Tch... you've got more manners than I gave you credit for. And more skill.

Plumeria.greeting: Po Town's rain gets old. Climbing up here to crush some kid's streak? Nice change.
Plumeria.trainerWins: Streak crushed. Now that's a nice change.
Plumeria.trainerLoses: Ugh. Back to the rain in Po Town, I guess.

Plumeria.greeting: Big sister Plumeria's gonna teach you a lesson, kid. Pay attention.
Plumeria.trainerWins: Class dismissed, kid. Big sis wins.
Plumeria.trainerLoses: Okay, kid. Big sis learned a lesson today.

Guzma.greeting: Big bad Guzma came all the way up this tree just to wreck your streak!
Guzma.trainerWins: That's how it's done! Nobody wrecks Guzma. Guzma does the wrecking!
Guzma.trainerLoses: Wrecked... AGAIN?! Why does this keep happening to me?!

Guzma.greeting: Guzma's the strongest Trainer on these islands! Ain't nobody squashing me!
Guzma.trainerLoses: Squashed... flat. Guzma got squashed! UGH!

Guzma.greeting: Team Skull's boss don't need a Z-Ring. I got pure destruction right here!
Guzma.trainerWins: Pure destruction! That's the Guzma way!
Guzma.trainerLoses: Destroyed... Guzma got destroyed. What is WRONG with this place?!

Kiawe.greeting: My spirit burns with the passion of Wela Volcano! Feel the heat!
Kiawe.trainerWins: Was the heat too much? Train hard and face the volcano again!
Kiawe.trainerLoses: Your spirit burned even hotter than the volcano. I salute you!

Kiawe.greeting: I dance the fire dance at Wela Volcano Park every night. Watch my Z-pose burn!
Kiawe.trainerWins: My fire dance never fails! Train hard and face it again!
Kiawe.trainerLoses: My fire dance fell flat... I'll practice until dawn!

Kiawe.greeting: Trial Captains never back down! I'll show you what a captain is made of!
Kiawe.trainerWins: That's a Trial Captain's strength! Train hard and return!
Kiawe.trainerLoses: You've shown me what a true challenger is made of. Truly impressive!

Mallow.greeting: I've cooked up a special battle menu just for you. Hope you've got an appetite!
Mallow.trainerWins: Seconds, anyone? You look like you've had enough!
Mallow.trainerLoses: You devoured my whole menu! I'll have to cook up something new.

Mallow.greeting: I picked these ingredients fresh from the Lush Jungle! Today's special: a jungle feast!
Mallow.trainerWins: Fresh from the jungle and served to perfection!
Mallow.trainerLoses: My jungle feast got eaten up! I'll forage for better ingredients!

Mallow.greeting: My secret recipe is so spicy it makes grown-ups cry! Ready for a taste?
Mallow.trainerWins: Spicy, right? Nobody's ever finished a full bowl!
Mallow.trainerLoses: Too much spice even for me... back to the kitchen!

Sina.greeting: Dexio and I came all the way from Kalos to research Alola's Pokémon. Let's battle!
Sina.trainerWins: That was great research! I can't wait to tell Dexio all about it!
Sina.trainerLoses: I'll have to report this loss to Dexio... he'll never let me hear the end of it!

Sina.greeting: Kalos is lovely, but Alola's beaches are something else! Let's battle by the sea!
Sina.trainerWins: Beach battle victory! I can't wait to tell Dexio!
Sina.trainerLoses: We got washed away... Dexio's going to tease me forever!

Sina.greeting: Dexio thinks I'm too cheerful for serious battles. Let's prove him wrong together!
Sina.trainerWins: Cheerful AND victorious! Take that, Dexio!
Sina.trainerLoses: Okay, maybe Dexio had a point. I'm still smiling, though!

Dexio.greeting: Sina and I are studying Alola's Pokémon. A battle with you should be very educational.
Dexio.trainerWins: Educational indeed. I'll write this one up for the professor.
Dexio.trainerLoses: Quite the lesson. Sina will laugh when she hears about this one.

Dexio.greeting: Professor Sycamore asked me to report on Alola's Trainers. Let's give him something to read.
Dexio.trainerWins: Report: Alolan Trainers have potential. Most of them.
Dexio.trainerLoses: Report: one Alolan Trainer is exceptional. That's you.

Dexio.greeting: These sunglasses aren't just fashion. Alola's sun is truly fierce, and so is my team.
Dexio.trainerWins: Fierce sun, fierce team. Simple science.
Dexio.trainerLoses: You outshone even the Alolan sun. Remarkable.

Brock.greeting: I'm studying to be a Pokémon Doctor. Battling you is good practice at reading what a partner needs.
Brock.trainerWins: Diagnosis: your team needs more rest and more training. Doctor's orders!
Brock.trainerLoses: A healthy team and a steady hand. No prescription needed.

Brock.greeting: Pewter City's a long way from Alola, but a good Gym Leader can set up camp anywhere.
Brock.trainerWins: Steady footing wins out. That's the first thing Pewter teaches you.
Brock.trainerLoses: You knocked my whole camp down. I'll pitch my tent somewhere quieter.

Brock.greeting: The nurses at Alola's Pokémon Centers are lovely... Focus, Brock. Battle first!
Brock.trainerWins: Win secured! Now, about that nurse at the front desk...
Brock.trainerLoses: Lost the battle AND my nerve to say hello. Rough day.

Misty.greeting: I'm the tomboyish mermaid of Cerulean City! My policy is an all-out offensive!
Misty.trainerWins: All-out offense, all the way! That's how it's done in Cerulean.
Misty.trainerLoses: You stopped my all-out offensive cold... Fine, you win this round!

Misty.greeting: Someone told me Alola's sunsets beat Cerulean Cape's. Let's settle this, then I'll check for myself!
Misty.trainerWins: Battle won! Now off to see if that sunset lives up to the hype.
Misty.trainerLoses: Okay, you beat me. But Cerulean Cape still has the better view.

Misty.greeting: Don't you dare call me a kid! I've been running a Gym for years!
Misty.trainerWins: See? Years of experience. Kid, my foot!
Misty.trainerLoses: Fine. You're the better Trainer today. Don't get a big head about it!

Lt. Surge.greeting: Hey, kid! The war hero of Vermilion is on vacation, but I never take a day off from winning!
Lt. Surge.trainerWins: Ha! Vacation or not, you got schooled, baby!
Lt. Surge.trainerLoses: Whoa! You're the real deal, kid. I salute you!

Lt. Surge.greeting: These islands remind me of my old service days. Ten-hut, soldier! Show me what you've got!
Lt. Surge.trainerWins: At ease, private. You've got a lot of drills ahead of you!
Lt. Surge.trainerLoses: Outranked by a kid! Consider me relieved of duty.

Lt. Surge.greeting: Sunglasses on, game face on! Let's see if you can handle a real veteran!
Lt. Surge.trainerWins: Shades stayed on the whole time. That's how you know I wasn't worried!
Lt. Surge.trainerLoses: I had to take the shades off for that one. Nice going, kid!

Erika.greeting: Oh... I must have dozed off in this lovely Alolan breeze. Shall we have a battle?
Erika.trainerWins: Oh my, I won? How lovely... I believe I'll take a little nap now.
Erika.trainerLoses: Oh, I concede... You battled beautifully. I'm quite wide awake now.

Erika.greeting: I teach flower arranging in Celadon City. A battle should be arranged just as gracefully.
Erika.trainerWins: Every piece in its place. A well-arranged battle indeed.
Erika.trainerLoses: You rearranged my whole arrangement. How very refreshing.

Erika.greeting: Celadon's perfume shop would adore the scent of Alola's hibiscus. I shall bring some home after our battle.
Erika.trainerWins: A victory as sweet as perfume. Thank you for the lovely match.
Erika.trainerLoses: Defeated... I suppose I'll console myself with some new perfume.

Janine.greeting: I'm Janine, daughter of the ninja master Koga! Father taught me to strike from the shadows!
Janine.trainerWins: Father would be proud! The ninja way never fails!
Janine.trainerLoses: Defeated... I still have much to learn from my father.

Janine.greeting: You found me? Most people walk right past. I've been hiding up here since sunrise!
Janine.trainerWins: Ha! Caught you off guard. That's ninja training for you!
Janine.trainerLoses: My cover is blown... and so is my winning record.

Janine.greeting: Alola's jungles are perfect for practicing vanishing tricks. Watch closely, or don't. You won't see it coming!
Janine.trainerWins: Poof! Gone before you knew it. Too slow!
Janine.trainerLoses: You saw right through my tricks. Hmph, impressive.

Sabrina.greeting: I foresaw your arrival at this tree three days ago. I also foresaw the outcome.
Sabrina.trainerWins: Exactly as I foresaw. The future rarely surprises me.
Sabrina.trainerLoses: This... was not the future I saw. How intriguing.

Sabrina.greeting: I bent a spoon with my mind when I was a child. Imagine what I can do to your streak.
Sabrina.trainerWins: Your streak bent just as easily as that spoon.
Sabrina.trainerLoses: My powers couldn't move you. You have a remarkably strong will.

Sabrina.greeting: I sense nervousness in you. Don't worry. It won't hurt for long.
Sabrina.trainerWins: Your nerves were right to worry.
Sabrina.trainerLoses: Your mind was calmer than I sensed. I misjudged you.

Blaine.greeting: Hah! Pop quiz! What do a Battle Tree streak and my old lab experiments have in common? They both blow up!
Blaine.trainerWins: Correct answer: your streak blew up. Hah!
Blaine.trainerLoses: Hah! You aced the quiz AND the battle. Full marks!

Blaine.greeting: I'm a scientist first and a Trainer second. Today's experiment: how long does your streak survive?
Blaine.trainerWins: Results recorded: not very long! Hah!
Blaine.trainerLoses: Experiment failed! I'll need to revise my hypothesis.

Blaine.greeting: After Cinnabar's volcano erupted, my Gym moved to the Seafoam Islands. I've been on the move ever since!
Blaine.trainerWins: Wherever I set up shop, I win! Hah!
Blaine.trainerLoses: Beaten! Looks like I'll be packing up and moving again.

Giovanni.greeting: I am Giovanni, leader of Team Rocket. I've come to see whether this tree is worth acquiring.
Giovanni.trainerWins: As expected. This tree will make a fine new asset.
Giovanni.trainerLoses: You remind me of a child who once ruined everything for me. Leave. Now.

Giovanni.greeting: In Viridian City I ran a Gym by day and an empire by night. You are merely a trial run.
Giovanni.trainerLoses: Impressive. Team Rocket could use someone like you... think about it.

Giovanni.greeting: I have bested Trainers from every world there is. Do you truly believe you're different?
Giovanni.trainerWins: No one is different. Everyone kneels eventually.
Giovanni.trainerLoses: ...So you are different. I'll remember your face.

Falkner.greeting: My father taught me everything I know. I'll show you the strength he passed down to me!
Falkner.trainerWins: Father, did you see that? We won!
Falkner.trainerLoses: I let my father down... I'll train even harder.

Falkner.greeting: Alola's trade winds are perfect for training. I've been riding them since I arrived!
Falkner.trainerWins: The wind was on my side today!
Falkner.trainerLoses: The wind changed direction... and so did the battle.

Falkner.greeting: People call my Gym the easiest in Johto. Today I'll prove them all wrong!
Falkner.trainerWins: Easiest Gym? I don't think so!
Falkner.trainerLoses: Maybe they had a point... No! I'll prove them wrong next time!

Bugsy.greeting: I'm doing research on Alola's wildlife! Battling you counts as fieldwork, right?
Bugsy.trainerWins: Great data! I'll write this one up tonight!
Bugsy.trainerLoses: Interesting results... I'll need to study them very closely.

Bugsy.greeting: I'm the youngest Gym Leader in Johto, but my research has made me a real expert!
Bugsy.trainerWins: Told you! Age doesn't matter when you know your stuff!
Bugsy.trainerLoses: Okay, you're the expert today. Can I take notes on your team?

Bugsy.greeting: I've filled three notebooks since I got to Alola! Let's fill another page with this battle.
Bugsy.trainerWins: Page complete! That's a victory for science!
Bugsy.trainerLoses: I'll have to cross out a few theories after that one.

Whitney.greeting: Everyone was into Pokémon, so I got into it too! And now I'm super good at it!
Whitney.trainerWins: Yay! I told you I was super good!
Whitney.trainerLoses: Waaah! You're so mean! ...Okay, I'm done crying. Good game.

Whitney.greeting: Goldenrod has the biggest department store, but Alola's malls are pretty cute too! Battle first, then shopping!
Whitney.trainerWins: Winning AND shopping? Best day ever!
Whitney.trainerLoses: Sniff... I lost. I need some retail therapy now.

Whitney.greeting: Don't make me cry, okay? Because if I cry, it gets really loud.
Whitney.trainerWins: No crying today! I'm way too happy!
Whitney.trainerLoses: WAAAAAH! ...Sorry, that was really loud, wasn't it?

Morty.greeting: I've trained my whole life to see the legendary bird of Ecruteak. I see strength in you, too.
Morty.trainerWins: My training showed me how this would end. Keep searching for your own legend.
Morty.trainerLoses: I didn't see that coming... and I'm supposed to see what others can't.

Morty.greeting: The ancient towers of Ecruteak taught me patience. This tree is just another tower to climb.
Morty.trainerWins: Patience pays off. Climb a little higher before you face me again.
Morty.trainerLoses: You climbed past me with ease. The towers would approve.

Morty.greeting: My scarf has a story behind it. I'll tell it to you, but only if you win.
Morty.trainerWins: I suppose the story stays with me, then.
Morty.trainerLoses: A promise is a promise. Someday, I'll tell you the whole story.

Chuck.greeting: WAHAHAH! I trained under a waterfall for years! A little battle won't faze me!
Chuck.trainerWins: WAHAHAH! The waterfall training pays off again!
Chuck.trainerLoses: Hmm... I need more time under that waterfall.

Chuck.greeting: My wife says I should take it easy on vacation. I say vacation is the perfect time to train!
Chuck.trainerWins: Ha! Don't tell my wife I won by training on vacation!
Chuck.trainerLoses: My wife's going to say 'I told you so.' Ugh.

Chuck.greeting: Alola's waves are as fierce as any waterfall! I've been training in them all week. HAH!
Chuck.trainerWins: The waves made me stronger! WAHAHAH!
Chuck.trainerLoses: Knocked flat... You hit harder than any wave.

Jasmine.greeting: Um... I'm Jasmine. Please don't go easy on me... I'll try my best, too.
Jasmine.trainerWins: Oh! I... I won? Thank you for the wonderful battle.
Jasmine.trainerLoses: You're very strong... I'll keep working hard, too.

Jasmine.greeting: Back home, I look after the lighthouse. Alola's lighthouses are so pretty... Um, let's battle.
Jasmine.trainerWins: Um... I'm happy. It was a gentle, good battle.
Jasmine.trainerLoses: You shine brighter than any lighthouse... Congratulations.

Jasmine.greeting: My dress isn't really made for the Battle Tree... but I wanted to battle you.
Jasmine.trainerWins: It was worth the trip... thank you.
Jasmine.trainerLoses: Um... I'll practice more, and come back.

Pryce.greeting: I have seen and suffered much in my long life. Let me show you what experience can do.
Pryce.trainerWins: Experience is a hard teacher. You have just had a lesson.
Pryce.trainerLoses: Hmm. Even an old man can learn something new.

Pryce.greeting: The warmth of Alola is strange to my old bones. My mind, however, is as sharp as ever.
Pryce.trainerWins: Sharp as ever. Don't let the gray hair fool you.
Pryce.trainerLoses: These old bones are tired... and you are very strong.

Pryce.greeting: Young people rush. Old men wait. Let us see which wins today.
Pryce.trainerWins: Patience wins, as it always has.
Pryce.trainerLoses: Perhaps rushing has its merits after all.

Clair.greeting: I am Clair, the world's best... and I've come to prove it on Alola's highest stage!
Clair.trainerWins: Exactly as expected. I am the best.
Clair.trainerLoses: I... lost? Fine. You may have earned some respect. Some.

Clair.greeting: My cousin Lance is a Champion. I won't lose to anyone while he's watching my results!
Clair.trainerWins: Let Lance hear about this victory!
Clair.trainerLoses: Don't you dare tell Lance about this.

Clair.greeting: This cape is a symbol of my clan's pride. Try not to get trampled under it.
Clair.trainerLoses: Hmph. My clan's elders will hear about this... unfortunately.

Roxanne.greeting: I graduated top of my class at the Trainers' School! Let's see how your studies measure up.
Roxanne.trainerWins: A textbook victory! Do review your notes.
Roxanne.trainerLoses: You've taught me something no textbook ever could.

Roxanne.greeting: I've prepared a lesson plan for this battle. Page one: you lose.
Roxanne.trainerWins: Lesson complete! I'd give you a C-plus.
Roxanne.trainerLoses: I'll have to rewrite the whole lesson plan... Excellent work.

Roxanne.greeting: Alola's Trainers' School is so lively! I came to observe, but I couldn't resist a battle.
Roxanne.trainerLoses: I came to observe, and I observed my own defeat. Noted.

Brawly.greeting: Dude! Alola's surf is unreal! Let's ride this battle like a monster wave!
Brawly.trainerWins: Totally shredded it! What a ride!

Brawly.greeting: I trained in the darkness of Granite Cave. Battling out here in the sun? Total bonus.
Brawly.trainerWins: Cave training never lets me down!
Brawly.trainerLoses: Back to the cave for me. Rad battle!

Brawly.greeting: I'm Brawly, and I'm here to catch the biggest wave of all: your winning streak!
Brawly.trainerWins: Caught it! Your streak was a totally sweet wave.
Brawly.trainerLoses: Your streak's too big a wave for me. Respect!

Wattson.greeting: Wahahahah! I came all the way to Alola to see their power plants. Let's have a rip-roaring good time!
Wattson.trainerWins: Wahahahah! What fun! Come back anytime, youngster!
Wattson.trainerLoses: Wahahahah! I lost! Well, that's fine. That was fun anyway!

Wattson.greeting: I've been tinkering with gadgets since before your parents were born! Wahahahah!
Wattson.trainerLoses: Time to tinker with my strategy. Wahahahah!

Wattson.greeting: Mauville's my city, but I hear Alola has some fine engineers too. Let's see how you're built!
Wattson.trainerLoses: You're built better than any machine I've made. Wahahahah!

Flannery.greeting: I'm the new Leader of Lavaridge! Alola's hot springs are... wait, focus! Let's battle!
Flannery.trainerWins: I did it! Grandpa would be so proud!
Flannery.trainerLoses: Ugh! I was too nervous again... I'll do better, Grandpa!

Flannery.greeting: My grandfather was the strongest Leader around. I'm going to make him proud!
Flannery.trainerLoses: I'll tell Grandpa I learned a lot... and lost a lot.

Flannery.greeting: I've been soaking in Alola's hot springs all week. I'm totally relaxed and ready to win!
Flannery.trainerWins: Relaxed AND victorious! Best vacation ever!
Flannery.trainerLoses: So much for relaxed... I'm all worked up now!

Norman.greeting: I'm Norman of Petalburg. I raised my child to be a great Trainer. Let's see how you were raised.
Norman.trainerWins: Good effort. Go home, rest up, and try again.
Norman.trainerLoses: You remind me of my own kid. I'm proud to have lost to you.

Norman.greeting: Strength isn't everything. But today, I intend to show you mine.
Norman.trainerWins: That's the strength of a father protecting his family.
Norman.trainerLoses: You've got more than strength. You've got heart.

Norman.greeting: My family vacation to Alola turned into a battling trip. Typical, really.
Norman.trainerLoses: Well, my kid's going to laugh when I tell them about this.

Winona.greeting: I've soared above Fortree's treetops for years. A tree like this one feels like home.
Winona.trainerWins: Grace and strength in perfect balance.
Winona.trainerLoses: You soared higher than me today. Beautiful.

Winona.greeting: The clouds over Alola move so gracefully. I hope our battle will be just as elegant.
Winona.trainerLoses: You were more elegant than I. Well done.

Winona.greeting: My goggles are on. Let's see if you can keep up!
Winona.trainerWins: You couldn't keep up. Train, and try again.
Winona.trainerLoses: I'll lift my goggles to you. You kept up and then some.

Tate.greeting: Hehehe! Without Liza, I'll have to battle on my own... but I'm still strong!
Tate.trainerWins: Hehehe! Liza's gonna be so jealous!
Tate.trainerLoses: Liza's going to tease me forever about this...

Tate.greeting: Mossdeep's Space Center has nothing on Alola's night sky! Let's battle under the stars!
Tate.trainerWins: The stars were on my side!
Tate.trainerLoses: I should've checked the star charts first...

Tate.greeting: I'm the older twin, by about three minutes. That makes me the leader today!
Tate.trainerWins: See? Three minutes of experience makes all the difference!
Tate.trainerLoses: Okay, maybe three minutes isn't a lot of experience.

Liza.greeting: Fufufu! Tate is battling somewhere else. That means I get you all to myself!
Liza.trainerLoses: Tate is going to laugh... I'll never hear the end of it.

Liza.greeting: I can always tell what Tate is thinking. Let's see if I can read you, too.
Liza.trainerWins: I read you like a book. Just like Tate.
Liza.trainerLoses: You're harder to read than my brother!

Liza.greeting: I'm the younger twin, but I'm the one with all the good ideas. Shh, don't tell Tate!
Liza.trainerWins: Another good idea, another win! Fufufu!
Liza.trainerLoses: Maybe I should have asked Tate for an idea...

Juan.greeting: Ah, a guest! I taught Wallace everything he knows. Shall I teach you a little elegance?
Juan.trainerWins: Bravo! An elegant performance, if I say so myself.
Juan.trainerLoses: Ahahaha! Splendid! You outshone even me.

Juan.greeting: Alola's seas sparkle almost as beautifully as Sootopolis. Almost.
Juan.trainerWins: As dazzling as Sootopolis at dawn. Bravo!
Juan.trainerLoses: Your brilliance outshines even Sootopolis. Magnificent.

Juan.greeting: Battling is an art, darling. Allow me to paint you a masterpiece.
Juan.trainerWins: The masterpiece is complete. Do admire it.
Juan.trainerLoses: You painted over my masterpiece! How bold. I love it.

Roark.greeting: I dug my way here from Oreburgh Mine! Okay, I took a boat. But I'm ready to battle!
Roark.trainerWins: Struck gold! That's a win for the miners!
Roark.trainerLoses: Back to the mines. I need to dig deeper for strength.

Roark.greeting: My dad thinks I'm still a kid. Beating you is going to show him!
Roark.trainerWins: Hah! Wait till Dad hears about this!
Roark.trainerLoses: Dad's never letting me forget this one.

Roark.greeting: My helmet lamp's on. I'm ready to dig up some fossils... er, I mean, some victories!
Roark.trainerWins: Dug up a victory! Not bad, right?
Roark.trainerLoses: Nothing but rubble today. Great battle!

Gardenia.greeting: Alola's forests are so lush! Let's have a battle that's just as lively!
Gardenia.trainerWins: Yay! I win! Let's celebrate in the forest!
Gardenia.trainerLoses: Aww, you got me! You're as tough as an old tree root!

Gardenia.greeting: Please tell me this tree isn't haunted... I really, really don't like spooky stuff.
Gardenia.trainerWins: Phew! No spooks and a win? Perfect!
Gardenia.trainerLoses: I lost... and I think I heard something creaking. Gotta go!

Gardenia.greeting: Eterna's old statue tells a lot of history. Today, I'm writing some of my own!
Gardenia.trainerWins: History made! Eterna will be proud!
Gardenia.trainerLoses: Guess that chapter of history belongs to you!

Fantina.greeting: Bonjour! I am Fantina, and I have come to dance in Alola's sunshine!
Fantina.trainerWins: Magnifique! What a dance we had!
Fantina.trainerLoses: Oh là là! You danced better than me today!

Fantina.greeting: In Hearthome, I win every Contest. Here, I shall win every battle, non?
Fantina.trainerWins: Oui, exactly as I said! Another win!
Fantina.trainerLoses: Non! This was not in my plan! You are très fort!

Fantina.greeting: My words, they are a little mixed up, but my battling? Très bien! Allons-y!
Fantina.trainerWins: You see? Très bien! Merci for the battle!
Fantina.trainerLoses: Ah, I am mixed up again... but you are wonderful!

Maylene.greeting: I walked barefoot all over Alola to toughen my feet. I'm ready for anything!
Maylene.trainerWins: Tough feet, tough heart! Thank you for the match!
Maylene.trainerLoses: My feet are tough, but you're tougher!

Maylene.greeting: I'm still learning to be a good Gym Leader. Please, give me everything you've got!
Maylene.trainerWins: I... I won! I'm getting better!
Maylene.trainerLoses: I still have so much to learn. Thank you, sincerely.

Maylene.greeting: Alola has the best food! I've eaten three plate lunches today, so I'm full of energy!
Maylene.trainerWins: Plate lunch power! It works every time!
Maylene.trainerLoses: Maybe four plate lunches next time...

Crasher Wake.greeting: I am... CRASHER WAKE! Here to crash your winning streak!
Crasher Wake.trainerWins: WAHAHAH! The streak has been CRASHED!
Crasher Wake.trainerLoses: I... have been crashed. Mighty battle, champ!

Crasher Wake.greeting: The mask stays on! In the ring or on the tree, Crasher Wake is always ready to rumble!
Crasher Wake.trainerWins: Another victory for the masked wrestler!
Crasher Wake.trainerLoses: The mask stays on, even in defeat! Well fought!

Crasher Wake.greeting: Alola's crowds are cheering for me! Let's give them a real show!
Crasher Wake.trainerWins: Did you hear that crowd?! What a show!
Crasher Wake.trainerLoses: The crowd's cheering for you now! Respect!

Byron.greeting: Gahahah! I'm Byron, Roark's dad! My boy says you're tough. Let's see!
Byron.trainerWins: Gahahah! Tell my boy his old man still has it!
Byron.trainerLoses: Gahahah! Beaten fair and square. Don't tell Roark!

Byron.greeting: I've spent my life digging tunnels. A tree's nothing but a tunnel pointing up! Gahahah!
Byron.trainerWins: Dug my way to the top! Gahahah!
Byron.trainerLoses: Hit bedrock... You're one tough Trainer.

Byron.greeting: Brought my shovel to Alola. Found nothing but sand and sunshine. Let's battle instead!
Byron.trainerWins: At least I found a win! Gahahah!
Byron.trainerLoses: No treasure and no win. Not my day!

Candice.greeting: Hiya! I'm Candice! When I focus, nothing can stop me! Let's go!
Candice.trainerWins: Focus, focus, focus! That's the secret!
Candice.trainerLoses: My focus slipped... but I'll get it back!

Candice.greeting: I'm not used to Alola's heat at all! I'm sweating through my scarf, but I won't give up!
Candice.trainerWins: Even in the heat, I win! Yay!
Candice.trainerLoses: Too hot to think straight... next time, I'll bring a fan!

Candice.greeting: Snowpoint's students cheer for me every day. I'm battling for them!
Candice.trainerWins: That was for my students back home!
Candice.trainerLoses: My students will help me train harder. Thank you!

Volkner.greeting: I've been bored for a long time. Can you make this battle worth my while?
Volkner.trainerLoses: Finally. That's the kind of battle I've been waiting for.

Volkner.greeting: I remodeled half of Sunyshore to pass the time. This tree is my next project.
Volkner.trainerWins: Project complete. You were a decent test.
Volkner.trainerLoses: My project failed. That's the most fun I've had in ages.

Volkner.greeting: Flint says I need more hobbies. So I came to Alola to battle. That's a hobby, right?
Volkner.trainerWins: Not a bad hobby after all.
Volkner.trainerLoses: Maybe my new hobby is losing to you. ...Kidding. Rematch soon.

Cheren.greeting: I teach at the Trainers' School in Aspertia. Consider this battle a pop quiz.
Cheren.trainerWins: You'll need to study a bit more. I'm happy to tutor you.
Cheren.trainerLoses: Full marks. You've taught the teacher something today.

Cheren.greeting: I used to want to be the Champion. Now I want to know what strength really means.
Cheren.trainerWins: Strength is more than winning... but winning helps.
Cheren.trainerLoses: Your strength answers a question I've been asking for years.

Cheren.greeting: Bianca dragged me to Alola. I suppose I should at least get some battling in.
Cheren.trainerWins: That was productive. Bianca will be pleased.
Cheren.trainerLoses: Bianca will never let me hear the end of this.

Roxie.greeting: Hey! My band's playing Alola tonight, but first I'm gonna rock your streak!
Roxie.trainerWins: Yeah! That's how we bring the house down!
Roxie.trainerLoses: Ugh, totally off-beat today! You were awesome, though!

Roxie.greeting: Everyone tells me to tone it down. Not today! Let's get LOUD!
Roxie.trainerWins: LOUD and PROUD! Thanks for jamming with me!
Roxie.trainerLoses: Okay, okay, I'll tone it down... after one more song.

Roxie.greeting: This battle's gonna be my next song! Hope you like heavy riffs!
Roxie.trainerWins: That's the hit single! Write it down!
Roxie.trainerLoses: Guess this song's about losing. Still a banger!

Burgh.greeting: Alola's colors are inspiring! I'll paint this battle as my next masterpiece!
Burgh.trainerWins: Inspiration strikes! I need my brushes!
Burgh.trainerLoses: My canvas is ruined... but what a wonderful mess!

Burgh.greeting: I've been in an artistic slump. Maybe a battle with you will inspire me!
Burgh.trainerWins: The slump is over! Thank you!
Burgh.trainerLoses: Still in a slump... but you've given me something to paint.

Burgh.greeting: Every Trainer has their own palette. Let's see the colors you've got!
Burgh.trainerWins: A bold palette, but mine had more depth.
Burgh.trainerLoses: Your colors outshone mine. Bravo, artist to artist!

Elesa.greeting: The runway lights of Nimbasa are nothing compared to Alola's sunshine. Shall we shine?
Elesa.trainerWins: Flawless, as always. The cameras love a winner.
Elesa.trainerLoses: You stole the spotlight. I'm impressed... and a little jealous.

Elesa.greeting: I just came from a photo shoot. Don't worry, I'm still dressed to battle.
Elesa.trainerWins: Even my outfit stayed perfect. That's a pro.
Elesa.trainerLoses: My hair's a mess... but it was worth it for that battle.

Elesa.greeting: My fans call me dazzling. Let's see if you can keep your eyes open.
Elesa.trainerWins: Dazzled, weren't you? It happens to everyone.
Elesa.trainerLoses: You weren't dazzled at all. That's rare. I like you.

Clay.greeting: Well, howdy! I didn't come all this way from Driftveil to lose, y'hear?
Clay.trainerLoses: Well, I'll be. You got more grit than a mine full o' gravel.

Clay.greeting: Runnin' a mine takes patience. So does winnin'. I got plenty of both!
Clay.trainerLoses: Reckon my patience ran out before your strength did.

Clay.greeting: This here hat's seen a hundred battles. Let's add one more to its story!
Clay.trainerWins: Another notch on the old hat!
Clay.trainerLoses: My hat's tippin' to you, partner.

Skyla.greeting: I flew my cargo plane all the way to Alola! Ready for takeoff?
Skyla.trainerWins: Smooth landing! That was a great flight!
Skyla.trainerLoses: Turbulence! You knocked me right off course!

Skyla.greeting: Alola's skies are so blue! I could fly here forever. But first, a battle!
Skyla.trainerWins: Clear skies and a win! Perfect day!
Skyla.trainerLoses: Clouds rolled in... and so did you. Nice!

Skyla.greeting: Mistralton's airport delivers packages all over. Today, I'm delivering a defeat!
Skyla.trainerLoses: Return to sender... Okay, you win!

Drayden.greeting: As mayor of Opelucid, I have met countless Trainers. Show me something I haven't seen.
Drayden.trainerLoses: That was new. Thank you for showing me.

Drayden.greeting: Even on vacation, a mayor's work is never done. Let us settle this quickly.
Drayden.trainerWins: Swift and decisive. That is leadership.
Drayden.trainerLoses: A mayor knows when to accept defeat. Well done.

Drayden.greeting: I have trained my body and mind for decades. Do not expect mercy from an old man.
Drayden.trainerWins: Decades of training. You'll catch up someday.
Drayden.trainerLoses: An old man's pride, humbled. You have a bright future.

Marlon.greeting: Yo! Alola's waves are pretty sweet. Let's just battle and chill, yeah?
Marlon.trainerLoses: You got me. That's cool. Wanna hit the beach after?

Marlon.greeting: Humilau's sea is the best, but Alola's got some real competition, ya know?
Marlon.trainerWins: Like the tide, I always come back on top!
Marlon.trainerLoses: Washed up on the beach... man, you're strong!

Marlon.greeting: No worries, no stress. Let's just have some fun battling, yeah?
Marlon.trainerWins: Fun times! I could battle like that all day.
Marlon.trainerLoses: No stress... except maybe a little now. Good game!

Chili.greeting: Ta-da! The top server of Striaton's restaurant has arrived! Let's get this party started!
Chili.trainerWins: Order up! One victory, extra spicy!
Chili.trainerLoses: I... I dropped the tray! You win this one!

Chili.greeting: My brothers are the cool, calm ones, but I'm the fun one! Let's go!
Chili.trainerWins: That's how the fun brother does it!
Chili.trainerLoses: Ugh, don't tell Cress and Cilan I lost!

Chili.greeting: I'm on break from the restaurant, so let's make this quick and loud!
Chili.trainerWins: Quick and loud! Back to work for me!
Chili.trainerLoses: My break's over, and so is my pride.

Cress.greeting: Welcome. Allow me to serve you a refined battle, prepared with care.
Cress.trainerWins: Thank you for dining. Please come again.
Cress.trainerLoses: A refined victory, I must admit. My compliments.

Cress.greeting: Chili is all noise, and Cilan is all theory. I am elegance itself.
Cress.trainerLoses: Even elegance must bow sometimes. Well played.

Cress.greeting: Alola's cuisine inspired a new menu at Striaton. Battle first; then I'll take your order.
Cress.trainerWins: Your order: one defeat, served with a smile.
Cress.trainerLoses: I'll add your victory to the menu. It was exquisite.

Cilan.greeting: It's evaluation time! Let me assess the flavor of your battling style.
Cilan.trainerWins: A promising flavor, but it needs more seasoning!
Cilan.trainerLoses: Exquisite! Your battle style has a truly rich aroma!

Cilan.greeting: As a Pokémon Connoisseur, I can tell a great Trainer at a glance. Let's see if I'm right!
Cilan.trainerWins: My assessment stands. You'll get there with time.
Cilan.trainerLoses: My assessment was wrong. You're even better than I thought!

Cilan.greeting: Alola's tropical fruits gave me so many new ideas. Let's blend them into this battle!
Cilan.trainerWins: A perfect blend, if I do say so myself!
Cilan.trainerLoses: Your blend was simply superior. Bravo!

Lenora.greeting: I run the Nacrene Museum. Let's see if your battling is worthy of an exhibit!
Lenora.trainerWins: Not quite museum-worthy yet. Keep at it!
Lenora.trainerLoses: That's going in the museum! What a battle!

Lenora.greeting: Alola's history is fascinating. I've been researching all morning. Now, let's battle!
Lenora.trainerWins: Research and victory in one day!
Lenora.trainerLoses: My research didn't predict that. Impressive!

Lenora.greeting: My husband says I take battles too seriously. I say he doesn't take them seriously enough!
Lenora.trainerLoses: Maybe I'll take it a little easier next time... maybe.

Brycen.greeting: Before I was a Gym Leader, I starred in action movies. Let's see if you're leading-role material!
Brycen.trainerWins: Cut! That's a wrap, and the victory is mine.
Brycen.trainerLoses: You stole the scene. A true star!

Brycen.greeting: I've returned to Pokéstar Studios for a new role. Today, I'm playing the victor!
Brycen.trainerLoses: That wasn't in the script! Brilliant improvisation.

Brycen.greeting: Icirrus taught me endurance. Alola's sun won't wear me down.

Bianca.greeting: Oh! Hi! I'm Bianca, Professor Juniper's assistant! I came to Alola to... um... research! And battle!
Bianca.trainerWins: Yay! I won! The professor's gonna be so happy!
Bianca.trainerLoses: Oh no, I lost... but that was really fun!

Bianca.greeting: Waaait! Don't start without me! Okay, I'm ready. Let's do this!
Bianca.trainerWins: Huff, huff... I made it! And I won!
Bianca.trainerLoses: I'm always a step behind... but I'll catch up!

Bianca.greeting: Cheren says I'm clumsy, but I'm way stronger than I used to be! Watch!
Bianca.trainerLoses: Ehehe... maybe a little clumsy still.

Marques.greeting: Time to battle with a heart of GOLD...

Tate.greeting: Hehehe! Did you think you'd face us one at a time?
We can feel each other's thoughts...

Liza.greeting: Our teamwork is out of this world!
